321.d: Geomeetriliselt üldistatud kompositsioon värvipindadest. Esiplaanil kahe haruna vasakust kuldlõikest ja paremast nurgast kokku voolav hallikassinine jõgi, nende vahel esiplaanil roheline neem tumepruunil (kruntimata lõuend) silmapiiril muutub jõgi kitsaks horisontaalseks viiruks. Keskplaanil paremal suure pruuni (kruntimata lõuend) värvipinnana puudemass, selle ees väiksem roosakasbeež lehtpuu. Ees vasakul liigendatud jõekallas pruunides toonides (kruntimata lõuend) rohekashalli ja summutatud hallikas - sinakasrohelise puudemassiga. Silmapiiril horisondi kohal ja osaliselt veepinnal hallikassinised värvipinnad. Hallikasvalge taevas. (eesti)
321.de: A geometrically generalised composition of colour planes. In the foreground, two branches of a greyish-blue river flowing together from the left golden section and the right corner; between them, in the foreground, a green headland on a dark brown (unprimed canvas) surface; on the horizon the river narrows into a horizontal streak. In the middle ground on the right, a mass of trees as a large brown (unprimed canvas) colour plane, in front of it a smaller pinkish-beige deciduous tree. In front on the left an articulated riverbank in brown tones (unprimed canvas), with a greenish-grey and muted greyish blue-green mass of trees. On the horizon, above the skyline and partly on the water surface, greyish-blue colour planes. A greyish-white sky.

861.de: Figural composition in a sauna dressing room, on the right sauna attendants sitting in white smocks, on the left bathers drying themselves and dressing in various poses.

862.d: Figuraalne kompositsioon suusavõistluste stardipaigast. Esiplaanil puhkpillioskester, paremal ja vasakul rühmadesse kogunenud inimesed, stardinumbrid rinnal ja seljal. Majaseintele toetuvad suusapaarid, maja ukse kõrval punased lipud. Heldur Viirese väitel on tegemist I Tartu Maratoni stardiga, kus osales ka kunstniku poeg.
862.de: A figural composition of a ski race starting point. In the foreground a brass band, on the right and left people gathered in groups, start numbers on their chests and backs. Pairs of skis leaning against the house walls, red flags beside the house door. According to Heldur Viires, this depicts the start of the 1st Tartu Marathon, in which the artist's son also took part.

864.d: Kubistlik kompositsioon erinevat kuju ja värvi kujunditega. Domineeriv punane kammitaoline kujund vasakul servas.

In front of the surfaces, on the vertical centre line, an abstract composition composed mainly of dark red segments, pink winding ribbons and a bench. Above this and at the sides, moulded relief shapes of plaster painted blue. At the bottom edge in the middle, three painted plaster relief shapes resembling balls.

3634.d: Maastik sinistes toonides. Ees keskel järv, paremal puudegrupp, vasakul tee. Taamal metsaga kaetud künkad,
3634.de: Landscape in blue tones. In the front centre a lake, on the right a group of trees, on the left a road. In the background hills covered with forest,

3635.d: Esiplaanil kollane põld viljahakkidega paremal, metsatuka ja hoonetega vasakul. Kaugemal kollased põllud, metsaga kaetud künkad ja veekogu vasakul.
3635.de: In the foreground a yellow field with sheaves of grain on the right, a copse and buildings on the left. Further away yellow fields, hills covered with forest and a body of water on the left.

3636.d: Punastes ja sinakates toonides linnavaade madalate majadega. Majade vahel ja esiplaanil puud. Taevas hele.
3636.de: A townscape in red and bluish tones with low houses. Trees among the houses and in the foreground. The sky is bright.

3638.d: Avar rannikupanoraam: teravasopilised merekäänud ja metsatukad, esiplaanil looklev tee, telefonipostid. Vormid üldistatud, kontuurid rõhutatud.
3638.de: A broad coastal panorama: sharply indented sea bays and clumps of forest, in the foreground a winding road, telephone poles. Forms generalised, contours emphasised.

3639.d: Kaks tütarlast, pilk vaatajale suunatud, istuvad kõrvuti, õmblustöö käes, ees madal korv. Seljas heledad pluusid. Foonis punakat.
3639.de: Two girls, gaze directed at the viewer, sitting side by side, needlework in hand, a low basket in front. Wearing light blouses. Reddish in the background.

3641.d: Sombreeros tumedahabemelise mehe poolfiguur otsevaates, käed puusas. Seljas sinine särk.
3641.de: Half-figure of a dark-bearded man in a sombrero, frontal view, hands on hips. Wearing a blue shirt.

3642.d: Natüürmort tumedast keraamilisest vaasist, valgest kannust, pudelist ja kausist. Laual õunu ja ploome. Foon punane-valge.
3642.de: Still life of a dark ceramic vase, a white jug, a bottle and a bowl. On the table, apples and plums. Background red and white.

3643.d: Künklik Lõuna-Eesti maastik soojades toonides. Paremal põldudega, vasakul metsaga kaetud voored.
3643.de: Hilly South Estonian landscape in warm tones. Drumlins covered with fields on the right, with forest on the left.

3644.d: Nelinurksel laual hele kann ümmargusel alusel, roheline pudel ja kolm suurt granaatõuna.
3644.de: On a rectangular table a light-coloured jug on a round base, a green bottle and three large pomegranates.

3645.d: Keskel kollase näoga naine, laps süles. Tema taga paremal ja vasakul kaks seisvat kolmveerandfiguuri ja üks ees alumises ääres nägu otsevaates.
3645.de: In the middle a woman with a yellow face, a child in her lap. Behind her on the right and left two standing three-quarter figures and one face in frontal view at the lower edge in front.

3647.d: Rühm inimesi põlevate tõrvikutega, keskel suur tuleleek.
3647.de: A group of people with burning torches, a large flame in the middle.

3651.d: Pildil paremal kolm erisuuruses kannu, keskmine, valge kann tilaga. Kannude taga, foonil naise kujutisega pilt. Pildil vasakul küünlajalg ühe küünlaga ja kogukas raamat; keskel ketiga lehmakell.
3651.de: On the right of the picture three jugs of different sizes, the middle, white jug with a spout. Behind the jugs, in the background a picture with the image of a woman. On the left of the picture a candlestick with one candle and a bulky book; in the middle a cowbell with a chain.

3652.d: Keskel, üle kogu pildi pinna elektrikitarr. Selle all pindade kombinatsioone moodustavad raamatute kujutised. All paremal suur mesikarp. Vasakul, kitarri taga moodustab mustvalge pinna malelaud. Kontuurid rõhutatud.
3652.de: In the middle, over the entire surface of the picture, an electric guitar. Below it images of books forming combinations of surfaces. At bottom right a large beehive. On the left, behind the guitar, a chessboard forms a black-and-white surface. Contours emphasised.

3653.dm: lehe laius: 53.6 cm; lehe kõrgus: 37.5 cm
3653.de: Wooded landscape with a large juniper

3655.d: Teravate kontuuridega, üldistatud joonistusega peamiselt mürkrohelistes toonides künklik maastik. Kompositsiooni alaäärest algav ja parema poole ülaosani kulgev astmeline tõus künkale, tihedate lehtpuudega kaetud järsem vasak serv. Kupli harjal tumeda siluetina puuderiba. Maali keskosas järsk kolmnurkne küngas, selle ees kolletav põlluriba. Vasakul org majakatusega, silmapiiril sujuvalt tõusev maapind metsaviiruga.
3655.de: A hilly landscape with sharp contours and generalised drawing, mainly in poisonous green tones. A stepped rise beginning at the lower edge of the composition and running to the upper part on the right side, towards a hill; a steeper left edge covered with dense deciduous trees. On the crest of the dome a strip of trees as a dark silhouette. In the middle of the painting a steep triangular hill, in front of it a strip of yellowing field. On the left a valley with a house roof, on the horizon a gently rising terrain with a strip of forest.

3658.d: Natüürmort laual ja selle taga asetseval kapil. Esiplaanil ümmargune tume laud, mis on osaliselt kaetud kergelt volti hoidva, heleda laudlinaga, mille serv ripub üle laua parema ääre. Sellel, esiplaanil, kollakas klaasist, kahe käepidemega, ümar puuviljavaagen kahe väiksema ja ühe suurema puuviljaga. Selle ees, laua katmata osal, kaardipakk ühe eralduva lehega. Vaagnast paremal, osaliselt selle all, ajakiri, ning selle peal helesinine raamatuköide. Vaagna taga lopsakates vormides suur keraamiline kann. Laua taga beežikas kapp sellele heidetud kirju riidega, mis piklikult kokku voldituna moodustab kapil hobuseraua kuju. Selle otsal, paremal, kaks õuna. Tume rohekaspruun foon.
3658.de: Still life on a table with a cabinet standing behind it. In the foreground a round dark table, partly covered with a light-coloured tablecloth held in a gentle fold, the edge of which hangs over the right side of the table. On it, in the foreground, a yellowish glass, round, two-handled fruit bowl with two smaller and one larger piece of fruit. In front of it, on the uncovered part of the table, a deck of cards with one card set apart. To the right of the bowl, partly beneath it, a magazine, and on top of it a light blue book binding. Behind the bowl a large ceramic jug of lush form. Behind the table a beige-coloured cabinet with a colourful cloth thrown over it, which, folded lengthwise, forms the shape of a horseshoe on the cabinet. At its end, on the right, two apples. Dark greenish-brown background.

3666.d: Esiplaanil viis inimfiguuri: keskel seisval mehel peas väike kübarakujuline müts, õlgadel pruun kuub, valge särgi rinna kohale on tõstetud vasaku käe kõverdatud peopesa. Esiplaanil seisva mehe selja taga heledapäine noor mees rohekas kuues, meeste vahel kaks heledasse rõivastunud valgetes pearätikutes naist, üks neist profiilis. Paremas servas sinist kapuutsi kohendav naine. Foonil künklik panoraammastik. Nurgelised vormid, koloriit peamisel roosakaspruun ja sinine.
3666.de: In the foreground five human figures: the man standing in the centre wears a small hat-like cap on his head, a brown coat on his shoulders, and the curved palm of his left hand is raised to the level of his white shirt's chest. Behind the man standing in the foreground is a fair-haired young man in a greenish coat; between the men are two women dressed in light clothing with white headscarves, one of them in profile. In the right edge a woman adjusting a blue hood. In the background a hilly panoramic landscape. Angular forms, the colour scheme mainly pinkish-brown and blue.

3667.d: Tumsesinise kaabuga mehe rinnaportree (vöökohani). Nägu suures osas kaabu varjus, rohelistes ja kollastes toonides. Seljas pruun kuub, tume särk ja hele vest. Figuur ja riideesemed ümbritsetud tumesinise kontuuriga, vormid kergelt geometriseeritud. Foon rohekas-sinine, läbi töötatud nähtavate, kohati roosade pintslilöökidega.
3667.de: A bust portrait (to the waist) of a man in a dark blue hat. The face is largely in the shadow of the hat, in green and yellow tones. He wears a brown coat, a dark shirt and a light waistcoat. The figure and clothing items are surrounded by a dark blue contour, the forms slightly geometricized. Background greenish-blue, worked through with visible, at places pinkish, brush strokes.

3668.d: Hallikassinisel järil istuv naine, peas valge ümarate servadega kübar, seljas rohelise kraega hele jakk, rohekas seelik ja ruudulised sukad. Naise süles heledas kleidis, punases mütsis ja sukkades ning rohelistes saabastes tüdruk. Nii naisel kui tüdrukul sirge nina, naisel pruunid, tüdrukul rohelised silmad. Foon keskosas ruuduline, pruun, servades hallikasrohelised triibud. Foonil vasakus nurgas hele väike ruut.
3668.de: A woman sitting on a greyish-blue sledge, on her head a white hat with rounded edges, wearing a light jacket with a green collar, a greenish skirt and checked stockings. In the woman's lap a girl in a light dress, a red cap and stockings, and green boots. Both the woman and the girl have straight noses, the woman has brown eyes, the girl green eyes. The background in the middle section is checked, brown, with greyish-green stripes at the edges. In the background, in the left corner, a small light square.

3678.d: Esiplaanil väike, nikerdatud jalgadega tumedast puust laud. Laual beeži-pruunitriibuline lina. Laual seadeldis: esiservas kaks ülestikku asetatud raamatut, pealmine neist rohelise kaanega. Raamatutel tume, hallikasroheline, altpoolt ahanev kauss, mille ülaservas kaks tumedat triipu. Raamatute taga paremal tumesinine, ülalt kitsa kaelaga vaas, milles suur kollane roos. Roosiga vaasist vasemal sale, ülaosas ahenev, sangaga pruun keraamiline vaas. Foon vanaroosades ja rohekassinistes toonides, servades on pisut imiteeritud draperiid.
3678.de: In the foreground a small table of dark wood with carved legs. On the table a beige-brown striped tablecloth. On the table an arrangement: at the front edge two books placed one on top of the other, the top one with a green cover. On the books a dark, greyish-green bowl narrowing at the bottom, with two dark stripes at its upper edge. Behind the books, on the right, a dark blue vase with a narrow neck at the top, in which a large yellow rose. To the left of the vase with the rose, a slender brown ceramic vase with a handle, narrowing at the top. The background is in old rose and greenish-blue tones, with slightly imitated drapery at the edges.

3679.d: Konstruktiivses laadis maalitud seadeldis: esiplaanil keskel valge, sinise koobaltmaailinguga kõhukas kann, millest paremal kaks siredat kõrgusesse pürgiva vormiga pudelit, kannu kohal sirelililla servaga sinine keraamiline taldrik või plaat. Esiplaanil vasakul kaks tuhmi sinepikollast tooni sidrunit. Maalitud summutatud sinistes, kollakates, rohelistes toonides, pindade kontuure tublisti rõhutades.
3679.de: An arrangement painted in a constructive manner: in the foreground centre a white, bulbous jug with blue cobalt design, to the right of which two slender bottles with upward-striving forms, above the jug a blue ceramic plate or platter with a lilac edge. In the foreground on the left two dull mustard-yellow toned lemons. Painted in muted blue, yellowish, green tones, strongly emphasising the contours of the surfaces.

3680.d: Panoraamne Lõuna-Eesti maastik mäeküngaste, nende vahel asuvate põllu- ja heinamaasiilude, puude ja metsatukkadega. Keskplaanis, puude ja küngaste vahel, madalad taluhooned, silmapiiril vasakul tumesinine metsa siluett. Ülal hallika pilvesäbruga kaetud roosa taevas. Maalitud rohelistes ja roosades toonides, looduse vorme kergelt geometriseerides. Kohati on värvikihti pinna elustamiseks veetud terava esemega kriipse.
3680.de: A panoramic South Estonian landscape with hillocks, strips of field and hayfield between them, trees and clumps of forest. In the middle ground, between the trees and hills, low farm buildings, on the horizon on the left a dark blue silhouette of forest. Above, a pink sky covered with a greyish fringe of clouds. Painted in green and pink tones, with the forms of nature lightly geometricised. In places, scratches have been drawn with a sharp object through the paint layer to enliven the surface.

3689.d: Künklik maastik. Esiplaanil oja ja sellest üle viiv rippsild, millel inimesi. Esiplaanil grupp istuvaid inimesi. Oja teisel kaldal puude all hulgaliselt inimesi.
3689.de: Hilly landscape. In the foreground a stream and a suspension bridge crossing over it, with people on it. In the foreground a group of seated people. On the other bank of the stream many people under the trees.

3691.d: Vasakul avaneva akna ette paigutatud lilleriiulil mitmesugustes pottides ja kastides lilli. Samasuguseid potililli ka paremal.
3691.de: On a flower shelf placed in front of a window opening to the left, flowers in various pots and boxes. Similar potted flowers also on the right.

3692.d: Hoogsa, dünaamilise pallimängu abstraheering: lõuendi keskosas, mida koondab nelinurk, on mängijad sirutunud palli suunas. Keskne stseen on organiseeritud punakate, sinakate, rohekate värvilaikude ja joonte rütmiga, mida piirab avaralt hele roosakates ja rohekates toonides foon.
3692.de: An abstraction of a vigorous, dynamic ball game: in the central part of the canvas, gathered into a quadrangle, the players are stretched towards the ball. The central scene is organized by a rhythm of reddish, bluish, greenish patches of colour and lines, bordered by an expansive light background in pinkish and greenish tones.

3693.d: Akna all laual mitmesuguseid potte ja kaste roheliste taimedega; akna heledale taustale tõusevad kaks kõrgemat laialehelist lille.
3693.de: On the table under the window various pots and boxes with green plants; against the light background of the window two taller broad-leaved flowers rise.

3695.d: Järsul mäeküljel alt vasakult üles paremale suunduv kääruline oja, mille kaldail üksikuid maju, puid.
3695.de: A winding stream running from lower left to upper right on a steep hillside, with a few houses and trees on its banks.

3696.d: Esiplaanil kitsa ribana org oja ja üksiku puuga; samas tõusevad järsult kõrged mäeahelikud, mis ulatuvad ülaservas heleda taevani.
3696.de: In the foreground a narrow strip of a valley with a stream and a solitary tree; at the same time high mountain ranges rise sharply, reaching to the bright sky at the upper edge.

3697.d: Rohelisel taustal eralduvad pehmelt üksikud puud ja madal lumise katusega maja.
3697.de: Against a green background, individual trees and a low house with a snow-covered roof stand out softly.

3698.d: Maalipinna keskosas naisefiguur otsevaates, tema taga tihedalt teised figuurid profiilis; nende ülessirutatud kätel lapsefiguur. Ülaservas päikeseketta kujutis.
3698.de: In the central part of the painted surface, a female figure in frontal view, behind her other figures tightly packed in profile; on their raised arms a figure of a child. In the upper edge, the image of a solar disc.

3699.d: Tihkelt üksteise läheduses seisvad figuurid, paigutatud maali keskplaanile. Koloriit hele, siniste aktsentidega.
3699.de: Figures standing closely together, placed in the middle ground of the painting. Colouring light, with blue accents.

3700.d: Abstraheeritud figuur üle pildi pinna. Heledal foonil pruunid kontuurid punakate ja siniste aktsentidega.
3700.de: An abstracted figure across the surface of the picture. Brown contours with reddish and blue accents on a light background.

3701.d: Pruunikais-beežikais-rohekates toonides kompositisoon viie tingliku naisfiguuriga, kellest äärmised istuvad.
3701.de: Composition in brownish-beige-greenish tones with five schematic female figures, of which the outer ones are seated.

3702.d: Esiplaanil laud toidunõudega. Selle juures sinises riietuses inimene; temast vasakul veel kolm figuuri.
3702.de: In the foreground a table with dishes of food. Beside it a person dressed in blue; to the left of them three more figures.

3703.d: Esiplaanil kolm seisvat figuuri. Nende taga lillakates ja rohekates toonides saal kuulajatega.
3703.de: In the foreground three standing figures. Behind them a hall in purplish and greenish tones with listeners.

3704.dm: laius: 180.0 cm ((kõik kolm osa)); kõrgus: 119.0 cm
3704.d: Musitseeriv orkester - paremal keelpillide mängijad, vasakul pianist.
3704.de: An orchestra making music - on the right string players, on the left a pianist.

3705.dm: laius: 180.0 cm ((kõik kolm osa)); kõrgus: 119.0 cm
3705.de: Young girls in a ballet class.

3706.dm: laius: 180.0 cm ((kõik kolm osa)); kõrgus: 119.0 cm
3706.d: Paremal neli figuuri - kaks seisvat ja kaks istuvat. Vasakul maalija molberti ees.
3706.de: On the right four figures - two standing and two sitting. On the left a painter before an easel.

3708.d: Keskel vasakul Lenini figuur, parem käsi tõstetud rinna kõrgusele. Paremal keskel kolm meest, kaks sõduri- ja üka madruseriietes. Vasakul- ning allääres stseenid Lenini elust. Üleval ääres ja ülal paremal nurgas sõdurid.
3708.de: In the centre left, the figure of Lenin, right hand raised to chest height. To the right in the centre, three men, two in soldier's and one in sailor's clothing. On the left and lower edges, scenes from Lenin's life. At the top edge and in the upper right corner, soldiers.

3710.d: Pastelsetes, põhiliselt pruunides ja rohelistes toonides pinadade kompositsioon. Kompositsiooni keskel valged pinnad.
3710.de: A composition of planes in pastel, mainly brown and green tones. White planes in the centre of the composition.

3711.d: Tumedates pehmetes toonides heledale taustale maalitud kompositsioon. Keskel laud paari heleda pudeli ja tassiga, selle taga üks naise ja kaks mehe figuuri. Kompositsiooni paremal serval veel üks figuur.
3711.de: A composition painted in dark, soft tones against a light background. In the centre a table with a pair of light-coloured bottles and a cup, behind it one female and two male figures. At the right edge of the composition, one more figure.

3712.d: Vasakul seisva, viiluit mängiva tütarlapse figuur. Paremal valge riidega kaetud laua ääres kaks istuvat figuuri. Tagaplaanil paistab aken.
3712.de: Figure of a girl standing on the left, playing the violin. On the right, by a table covered with white cloth, two seated figures. In the background a window is visible.

3713.d: Rohekal foonil sinise tooniga antud kompositsiooniline grupp inimese ülakeha ja hobuse alakehaga figuuridest. Grupi tsentris, samuti äärtel rohkesti mustjaspruune ja mustjassiniseid pindu.
3713.de: On a greenish background, given in blue tones, a compositional group of figures with human upper bodies and horse lower bodies. In the centre of the group, as well as at the edges, plenty of blackish-brown and blackish-blue planes.

3714.d: Fooniks mustad ja pruunid pinnad. Esiplaanil valgete ja mustade joontega antus neli inimfiguuri. Vasakpoolse figuuri pea kallutatud vasakule.
3714.de: Background of black and brown surfaces. In the foreground four human figures rendered with white and black lines. The head of the left figure tilted to the left.

3715.d: Rohekad ja pruunikad jooned ning pinnad moodustavad abstraktsete inimfiguuride grupi. Siin-seal üle kogu pildi pinna sinakaslillad pinnad.
3715.de: Greenish and brownish lines and surfaces form a group of abstract human figures. Here and there over the whole surface of the picture bluish-purple surfaces.

3716.d: Kompositsioon pruunikas-hallis koloriidis, mõne roosaka pinnaga. Esiplaanil terrass, millel mehe ja naise seisvad figuurid. Nende ees terrassil kaks valget tuvi. Tagaplaanil majad.
3716.de: Composition in brownish-grey coloring, with some pinkish surfaces. In the foreground a terrace, on which stand the figures of a man and a woman. In front of them on the terrace two white doves. In the background houses.

3721.d: Tumedas koloriidis kompositsioon kolmest figuurist. Keskmise figuuri juures üksikud ookerjad ning oranžikad pinnad.
3721.de: Composition of three figures in a dark colour scheme. Near the middle figure, individual ochre and orangish areas.

3735.d: Pruunikas-rohelistes, keskosas pastelsetes roosakais ja kollastes toonides joontest ning pindadest abstraktne kompositsioon.
3735.de: Abstract composition of lines and surfaces in brownish-green, in the middle part in pastel pinkish and yellow tones.

3740.d: Pruunides, hallides, sinistes ja kollastes toonides abstraktne, väga dünaamiline kompositsioon, mille jooonterägust on aimatavad vaataja poole pööratud näod ja ülestõstetud käed. Hoogsate, selgelt eristuvate, impulsiivsete pintslilöökidega maalitud.
3740.de: Abstract, highly dynamic composition in brown, grey, blue and yellow tones, in whose linear texture faces turned toward the viewer and raised hands can be discerned. Painted with vigorous, clearly distinguishable, impulsive brushstrokes.

3748.dm: lehe kõrgus: 64.8 cm; kujutise laius: 45.8 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 54.8 cm; kujutise laius: 51.0 cm
3748.d: mitmevärviline kompositsioon, all keskel tume mehefiguur
3748.de: a multicoloured composition, with a dark male figure at the bottom centre

3749.dm: laius: 64.4 cm (lm.); kõrgus: 46.0 cm (km.); kõrgus: 49.7 cm (lm.); laius: 60.6 cm (km.)
3749.d: Hallikassinisel foonil üks valkjas ja teine kollakashall kujund. Valkjal kujundil tumedad triibud, hallil tumedad laiad triibud ja erepunane hieroglüüfiline märk.
3749.de: On a greyish-blue background one whitish and one yellowish-grey shape. On the whitish shape dark stripes, on the grey one dark wide stripes and a bright red hieroglyphic mark.

3753.dm: laius: 79.6 cm (lm.   ); kõrgus: 56.7 cm (km.   ); kõrgus: 59.7 cm (lm.   ); laius: 75.5 cm (km.   )
3753.d: Hallikassinisel abstraktsel foonil punakad ja sinised jooned ja laigud.
3753.de: Reddish and blue lines and spots on a greyish-blue abstract background.

3759.dm: lehe kõrgus: 54.1 cm; lehe laius: 45.0 cm; kujutise laius: 34.8 cm; kujutise kõrgus: 46.1 cm
3759.d: Westward, mixed techniques 8/20 1968 Asukoht objektil: all vasakul
3759.de: Westward, mixed techniques 8/20 1968 Location on object: lower left

3766.dm: kõrgus: 58.8 cm (lm.   ); laius: 45.6 cm (km.); laius: 48.8 cm (lm.); kõrgus: 55.3 cm (km.   )
3766.d: Osaliselt üksteist katvate abstraktsete värviliste pindade kombinatsioon.
3766.de: A combination of abstract coloured surfaces partially overlapping one another.

3768.dm: lehe kõrgus: 59.8 cm (lm.   ); kujutise laius: 76.0 cm (km.); lehe laius: 79.8 cm (lm.); kujutise kõrgus: 56.0 cm (km.   )
3768.d: Punasel foonil lamab pisut kõverdatud põlvedega naisakt, pea toetub küünarnukist kõverdatud käele, kehale langevad tugevad punase ja rohelise värviga antud varjud. Naise kohevad juuksed mürkrohelised. Foonil, paremas ülanurgas, mitmes rohelises toonis abstraktsed pinnad, helerohelisel laigul suur kollane ja värvilisi väikeseid geomeetrilise kujundeid. Naise küünarnukk toetub sinise-rohelise-mustrilisele vaibale.
3768.de: On a red background lies a female nude with slightly bent knees, her head resting on an arm bent at the elbow, strong shadows in red and green colour falling on the body. The woman's fluffy hair is poisonous green. In the background, in the upper right corner, abstract surfaces in several green tones, on a light green patch a large yellow shape and small colourful geometric figures. The woman's elbow rests on a blue-green-patterned rug.

3769.dm: laius: 47.0 cm (vm.); kõrgus: 55.0 cm (km.); kõrgus: 56.3 cm (vm.); laius: 46.0 cm (km.)
3769.d: Mustale, kohati heledat paberipinda paista laskvale foonile on spontaanselt pritsitud mitmevärvilised laigud.

4111.d: Punakaslilla taust, mis maali keskmes muutub heledamaks. Selle keskel kummuli neerukujuline mattmust kujund ümbritsetud eenduva sakiliste servadega oranži pärjaga, mille ebaühtlane äär kooldub musta pinna peale. Viimane kaetud luminiseeruva hõõguva värviga, nired voolamas taustale. Maali allosas mustjashall maapinna läbilõige, rakukujulised pinnasekihid ebaühtlaste triipudena.
4111.de: A reddish-purple background, which becomes lighter towards the centre of the painting. In its centre an upside-down kidney-shaped matte black form surrounded by a projecting, jaggedly edged orange wreath, whose uneven edge curls over the black surface. The latter is covered with a luminescent, glowing paint, with rivulets flowing onto the background. In the lower part of the painting a blackish-grey cross-section of the ground, cell-shaped soil layers in uneven stripes.

4248.d: Esiplaanil hall jässakas hoone trellitatud akna ja kahe uksega. Selle taga punaste viilkatustega majad.
4248.de: In the foreground a grey stocky building with a barred window and two doors. Behind it houses with red gabled roofs.

4249.d: Põhja-Venemaa maastik erkroheliste küngastega esiplaanil. Taamal metsaga kaetud künkad ja majad kobaras koos. Taevas sinakasroheline, hulga valgete rünkpilvedega.
4249.de: Northern Russian landscape with bright green hillocks in the foreground. Beyond, forested hills and houses clustered together. Sky bluish-green, with many white cumulus clouds.

4250.d: Siniste silmade ja sinise kleidiga naise portree, pea kerges pöördes vasakule. Heledad juuksed maalitud pastoosselt.
4250.de: Portrait of a woman with blue eyes and a blue dress, head turned slightly to the left. Light hair painted in impasto.

4251.d: Rohelisel alusel punakas vaskkann, kummaline valgete täppidega ese ja madal vaas sinililledega. Nende taga punasel foonil ikoon.
4251.de: On a green base a reddish copper jug, a strange object with white dots and a low vase with hepaticas. Behind them an icon on a red background.

4252.d: Pruunikal foonil tumepruun korv viie rohelise pirniga.
4252.de: Dark brown basket with five green pears on a brownish background.

4253.d: Lumisel mäenõlval grupp sõdureid suusatamas. Esiplaanil keskel selgvaates sõdurid mäkke tõusmas, paremal mäest laskuvad sõdurid.
4253.de: On a snowy mountain slope a group of soldiers skiing. In the foreground in the middle, seen from the front, soldiers climbing the mountain, on the right soldiers descending the mountain.

4254.d: Künklik maastik kollaste põldudega ja üksikute puudegruppidega.
4254.de: Hilly landscape with yellow fields and single groups of trees.

4257.d: Esiplaanil laud einega ja selle ümber neli mehe ja üks naise figuur. Fooniks helesinine taevas.
4257.de: In the foreground a table with a meal and around it four male figures and one female figure. Background a light blue sky.

4258.d: Oranzil foonil esiplaanil pruunikas laud. Laual pruun, punutud korv õuntega ja selle taga üks rohekas nõu. Paremal serval paistab pool kederlauast.
4258.de: On an orange background in the foreground a brownish table. On the table a brown, woven basket with apples and behind it a greenish vessel. On the right edge half of a potter's wheel is visible.

4260.d: Esiplaanil roheline laineline maariba, mille tagant paistavad kaks reha. Keskosas heinamaa heinasaadudega. Paremal grupp heinalisi ja hobune. Tagaplaanil mets. Taevas kollane.
4260.de: In the foreground a green wavy strip of land, behind which two rakes can be seen. In the middle section a hayfield with haycocks. On the right a group of haymakers and a horse. In the background, forest. Sky yellow.

4263.d: Valgel foonil kollasel alusel ebakorrapärase kujuga kauss selle sees oleva puust kulbiga. Ülal vasakul väike pruunis toonis nelinurga-kujuline laik.
4263.de: On a white background, on a yellow base, an irregularly shaped bowl with a wooden ladle inside it. Above on the left a small brownish-toned rectangular-shaped patch.

4264.d: Rohekal foonil valgel riidel kaks tumedat vasknõud ning kolm pirni.
4264.de: Against a greenish background, on white cloth two dark copper vessels and three pears.

4265.d: Ees paremal servas pastoosselt maalitud mustriga kederlaud ja võtmemustriline kangatükk. Tagaplaanil korvid, ühes neist kolm rohelist lõngakera.
4265.de: In the front right margin, a spinning-wheel distaff painted with a pattern in a pastose manner and a piece of fabric with a key pattern. In the background, baskets, in one of them three green balls of yarn.

4274.d: Valgel riidel kuus sügavpunast granaatõuna ning valkjas peeker. Vorm kergelt deformeerunud.
4274.de: On a white cloth six deep red pomegranates and a whitish goblet. The form slightly deformed.

4278.d: Rõhutatult dekoratiivselt ja ümaralt antud roheliste küngaste vahel keskel tume terava torniga puukirik ja selle taga väikese saleda torni ja pruuni katusega valge kirik. Valgest kirikust paremal üksik puu. Taevas sinine, keskosa pilved antud valgete komataoliste pintslilöökidega.
4278.de: Emphatically decoratively and roundly rendered among green hills, in the centre a dark wooden church with a sharp tower, and behind it a white church with a small slender tower and a brown roof. To the right of the white church a solitary tree. The sky is blue, the middle part with clouds rendered with white comma-like brush strokes.

4279.d: Keskel vertikaalselt ülespoole sööstev lennuk valget juttu maha jätmas. Üle pildi pinna taevas, valged pilved, kahelt poolt servast paistavad lennukitiivad, vasakpoolsel punane viisnurk. Ülaserv roosa, vasakul punane päike. Maalitud pastoosselt, kohati spaatliga värvi hõõrudes.
4279.de: In the centre, an aircraft shooting vertically upward, leaving white trail behind. Across the picture surface, sky, white clouds, aircraft wings visible from both edges, a red five-pointed star on the left side. Upper edge pink, red sun on the left. Painted pastosely, with the paint rubbed in places with a palette knife.

4285.d: Keskel, punakaspruunide küngaste vahel mustjashallide ehituspostide grupp. Taga, silmapiiril uusrajooni paneelmajade müür, selle ees lehviv pesu, paremal katkine lapsevanker. Taga vasakul, mustendava taeva taustal heledad ehituspostid.
4285.de: In the middle, among reddish-brown hillocks, a group of blackish-grey construction posts. Behind, on the horizon, the wall of panel houses of a new district, in front of it fluttering laundry, on the right a broken pram. Behind on the left, against a blackening sky, light-coloured construction posts.

4320.d: Rohelisel alusel keskel viis tumepunast väikest õuna, munapeeker munaga ning plekist piimanõu. Paremale jääb kõrvaga suur savikruus; vasakule kõhukas sangaga kann.
4320.de: On a green base in the middle five small dark red apples, an egg cup with an egg, and a tin milk vessel. To the right a large clay jug with a handle; to the left a bulbous jug with a handle.

4321.d: Ümaral alusel keskel tume, peaaegu mustjas pudel ja väike tumehall teekann; nende taga kägardunud valge paber. Pudeli ees sinine riie, millel kahes grupis viis rohelist pirni.
4321.de: In the centre on a round base a dark, almost blackish bottle and a small dark grey teapot; behind them crumpled white paper. In front of the bottle a blue cloth on which five green pears in two groups.

4323.d: Roosal alusel tume klaaspudel ja roheline savikauss punaste õuntega, kaks õuna kausi ees.
4323.de: On a pink base a dark glass bottle and a green clay bowl with red apples, two apples in front of the bowl.

4324.d: Esiplaanil diagonaalselt roheline kividega ääristatud rannariba. Merepind tasane, tinajas, silmapiiri poole tumenev. Taevas kaetud madalate sinakas-hallide pilvedega.
4324.de: In the foreground diagonally a green coastal strip bordered with stones. The sea surface calm, pewter-coloured, darkening towards the horizon. The sky covered with low bluish-grey clouds.

4325.d: Vaade kitsale äärelinna tänavale ja madalate kivimajade rägastikule.
4325.de: View of a narrow suburban street and a maze of low stone houses.

4326.d: Tumesinisel alusel mahukas vaskne kohvikann, savipurk ning hele tass koos alusega. Kontrastse laigu üldises tumedas koloriidis moodustavad kaks oranži apelsini. Esemed peenelt modelleeritud.
4326.de: On a dark blue base a voluminous copper coffee pot, a clay jug and a light-coloured cup with its saucer. Two orange oranges form a contrasting spot in the generally dark colour scheme. The objects are finely modelled.

4332.d: Geomeetrilistest ja ruumiliselt mõjuvatest värvilaikudest koosnev kompositsioon. Üksikud pintslilöögid selgelt eristatavad, värvitoonide hulgast hoolimata domineerib summutatud pruunikashall koloriit.
4332.de: A composition consisting of geometric and spatially effective patches of colour. Individual brushstrokes are clearly distinguishable, and despite the variety of colour tones, a muted brownish-grey colouring dominates.

4336.d: Rohelistes, kollastes ja punastes värvitoonides maastik, komponeeritud erinevate värvipindade koosmõju arvestades. Pildi allosas lagendik, keskel puudemassiiv, ülal taevas, kõik tugevas geomeetrilises üldistuses antud, hoogsad pikad pintslilöögid.
4336.de: A landscape in green, yellow and red tones, composed with regard to the interaction of different colour planes. At the bottom of the picture a clearing, in the middle a mass of trees, above the sky, all rendered in strong geometric generalisation, with vigorous long brushstrokes.

4344.d: Sinistes ja rohelistes toonides, kolmnurgakujulise küljega hulktahukatest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon.
4344.de: Abstract composition in blue and green tones, consisting of polyhedra with triangular-shaped sides.

4346.d: Ülal keskel on lõuendile kleebitud paberist märklaud, tumeda ümara kujundi foonile. Märklaua alt voolab välja roosa, tilka meenutav kujund. Keskel, horisontaalse keskjoone kohal, kummaski servas kaks vastakuti pööratud läätsemotiivi, mida ühendab peen valge horisontaaljoon. Allservas keskel on mustale, läätse meenutavale pinnale kleebitud lambanaha tükike. Külmades sinistes toonides. Must paspartuu.
4346.de: In the upper centre a paper target is glued to the canvas, against the background of a dark round shape. From under the target flows a pink, drop-like shape. In the centre, above the horizontal midline, on each side two lens motifs turned towards each other, connected by a fine white horizontal line. In the lower centre, a piece of sheepskin is glued to a black, lens-like surface. In cold blue tones. Black mount.

4368.de: Abstract composition predominantly in purple tones.

4369.d: Punakas-kollasel foonil naeratava mehe poolfiguur - seljas pintsak, peas kaabu, käes kala. Ülal paremal tagurpidi lilleoks
4369.de: Half-figure of a smiling man on a reddish-yellow background - wearing a jacket, a hat on his head, a fish in his hand. Upper right an upside-down flower branch

4370.dm: lehe laius: 22.5 cm; lehe kõrgus: 32.0 cm
4370.d: Mustjas-pruunil foonil naise poolfiguur - sinine, avara kaeluse ja lühikeste käistega pluus, heledad lühikesed juuksed, ilme tõsine ning eemalolev. Taevas noorkuu. Kahel pool figuuri liiliamotiiv. Neist parempoolsel lillel istumas väike valge lind
4370.de: On a blackish-brown background a half-figure of a woman - a blue blouse with a wide neckline and short sleeves, light short hair, a serious and distant expression. In the sky a crescent moon. On both sides of the figure a lily motif. On the right-hand flower sits a small white bird

4373.d: Sinise rätiga punapäise naise poolfiguur otsevaates sügisese pargi foonil.
4373.de: Half-figure portrait of a red-haired woman with a blue kerchief, frontal view, against a background of an autumn park.

4402.d: Keskel, vertikaalsel keskteljel, punakaspruunide pindade vahel sinine, kord ahenev, teisal laienev pragu. Prao allosas varda otsas seisev valge kuulike. Ülaserv süsimust. Pruuni fooni paremas ülemises neljandikus samades toonides mandlikujuline, väga pastoosselt maalitud pind.
4402.de: In the centre, on the vertical central axis, between reddish-brown surfaces a blue crack, narrowing in places, widening in others. At the bottom of the crack, a small white ball standing on a rod. The upper edge pitch-black. In the upper right quarter of the brown background, in the same tones, an almond-shaped surface, painted very pastosely.

4403.d: Vertikaalselt üle pildi pinna ulatuva naise torso: keskjoon jagab keha kaheks pooleks, millest vasakpoolne on ookerpruun, parem pool kuldpruun. Ülaservas stiliseeritud rinnapartii, niuete kohal suur hall kuul. Foon punakaspruun.
4403.de: A woman's torso extending vertically across the picture surface: a central line divides the body into two halves, of which the left is ochre-brown, the right side golden-brown. At the upper edge a stylised bust area, above the hips a large grey ball. Background reddish-brown.

4404.d: Süsimustas kuues mehefiguur: suurte kõrvadega pea, kahvatu näojume, tuhmid helepruunid juuksed püsti, pilk otse vaatajale suunatud. Keskel, musta kuue hõlmade vahel punase haavana mõjuv pilu, millest paistab helesinine lips. Kuue parempoolsel hõlmal seitse pildi pinnale kleebitud ehtsat nööpi (valged, kuldse servaga). Kuue vasakpoolsele hõlmale on maalitud nööpaugupilud. Foon lillakaspruun.
4404.de: A male figure in a coal-black coat: a head with large ears, a pale complexion, dull light-brown hair standing up, gaze directed straight at the viewer. In the middle, between the flaps of the black coat, a slit resembling a red wound, from which a light blue tie shows. On the right flap of the coat seven genuine buttons (white, with a gold edge) glued to the surface of the picture. On the left flap of the coat buttonhole slits are painted. Background purplish-brown.

4405.d: Hallides ja pruunides toonides figuraalne kompositsioon: paremal ja ülal suured kivimürakad, vasakul alasti lihaseline mehefiguur. Mehe parem käsi ülal kaljus, pea kuklas, pärani silmade ja suuga nägu taeva poole suunatud. Figuuritagune foon tumepruun.
4405.de: A figural composition in grey and brown tones: on the right and above, large rock masses, on the left a naked muscular male figure. The man's right hand is up on the rock, his head thrown back, his face with wide-open eyes and mouth turned toward the sky. The background behind the figure is dark brown.

4408.d: Punakaslilla valgusega estraadilava tautsal kolme noore naise kolmveerandfiguurid mikrofoni ees, miimika ja žestide järgi andunud laulmisele. Pildi all vasakul kahe meeskuulaja nägu. Üldistav maalilaad.
4408.de: Against a purplish-pink lit variety stage background, three-quarter figures of three young women in front of a microphone, their mimicry and gestures showing devoted singing. At the bottom left of the picture, the faces of two male listeners. A generalizing painting style.

4409.d: Pruunikais-hallikais toonides maali all vasakul profiilis tumedapäise mehe rinnaportree vaatega paremale. All paremal talle vastu vaatav sarnane pikkade tumedate juustega profiilne naiseportree. Naisel punakas-roosakas rõivastus, mehel valge krae, tume ülikond. Ülal keskel tume, aknaava meenutav ruut, millesse asetatud punakaspruun ümar vaas väikese valge lillega. Maali keskpinda moodustavad tantsivad inimfiguurid, kubistlikus laadis maalituna.
4409.de: In brownish-grey tones, lower left of the painting, a bust portrait of a dark-haired man in profile facing right. Lower right, a similar profile portrait of a woman with long dark hair looking back at him. The woman wears reddish-pink clothing, the man a white collar and a dark suit. Upper centre, a dark square resembling a window opening, in which is placed a reddish-brown round vase with a small white flower. The central area of the painting is formed by dancing human figures, painted in a cubist manner.

4412.d: Sürrealistlik kompositsioon, mis on jaotatud horisontaalselt kaheks eri värvi pinnaks. Ülemisel valgel pinnal külg külje kõrval sirgus neli kirjut triibulist ja ruudulist lipsu. Alumisel roostekarva pinnal pastoosselt maalitud vagiinamotiiv, mille sees lusika kujutis.
4412.de: Surrealist composition divided horizontally into two areas of different colour. On the upper white area, four colourful striped and checked ties stand side by side. On the lower rust-coloured area, a vagina motif painted pastosely, containing the depiction of a spoon.

4666.d: Keskjoonest ülalpool mustjaspruunist taustast vormub sujuvalt välja hõõguvpunane drapeeritud reljeefne kujund, paksult värviga kaetud. Kujundi voltide vahel üks tilgakujuline meresinine, teine kollakas pind. Kujundi alumine pool aheneb ja muutub pinnaliseks keskjooone suunas. Kompositsiooni alumisel poolel tumepruunil taustal sama värvi vineerist saetud ja kihiti astmeliselt üksteise peal asetatud nurksed ja kaarja servaga vormid. Kolm metallneetidest poolkaart all keskel, väiksem vasakul äärel ja paremal vineerikujundil.
4666.de: Above the midline, out of a blackish-brown background, a glowing red draped relief-like form emerges smoothly, thickly covered with paint. Between the folds of the form, one drop-shaped sea-blue area and another yellowish area. The lower half of the form narrows and becomes flat toward the midline. In the lower half of the composition, on a dark brown background, angular and curved-edged forms sawn from plywood of the same colour are placed in stepped layers one on top of the other. Three semicircles of metal rivets at the bottom centre, a smaller one on the left edge and on the right on the plywood form.

5680.de: An abstract composition consisting of patches of colour in various shades of brown. Very pastose texture, in places the plywood has grooves and scratches gouged into it.

5681.d: Lokiliste juuste ja lõuahabemega noorepoolse mehe poolfiguur poolpöördes vasakule, nõjatumas tinglikule istmele, parem käsi vabalt rippu. Mehel veidi naerusuine ilme, silmad helesiniste rõngastega modelleeritud. Seljas sinikollane särk-pluus. Dekoratiivne voolav maalilaad, helesinised lained ümbritsevad figuuri.
5681.de: Half-figure of a fairly young man with curly hair and a chin beard, in a half-turn to the left, leaning on a conventional seat, right arm hanging freely. The man has a slightly smiling expression, eyes modelled with light blue rings. Wearing a blue-yellow shirt-blouse. Decorative flowing painting style, light blue waves surround the figure.

5716.d: Maali keskel seisev noor mees otsevaates, parem käsi üle rinna. Kandilised näojooned, tõsine ilme, pruunikad juuksed üle pea kammitud, tugevad soonilised käed. Seljas üleskääritud käistega särk, sinkjad püksid, sandaalid jalas. Taust tellisseina imiteerivate kraapsudega hele pind. Nurgeline kujutamisviis.
5716.de: In the middle of the painting a young man standing in a frontal view, right hand across his chest. Angular facial features, serious expression, brownish hair combed back over his head, strong sinewy hands. Wearing a shirt with rolled-up sleeves, bluish trousers, sandals on his feet. Background a light surface with scratches imitating a brick wall. Angular manner of depiction.

5717.d: Harkisjalu seisev üle keskea mees, parem käsi puusal, veerandpöördes paremale. Mehel kortsuline piklik nägu, otse suunatud tõsine pilk, ülepea kammitud tumedad juuksed. Sinise jaki alt paistab punakas särk, tumedad püksid, jalanõud. Tausta ülemine pool intensiivne koobaltsinine, all vasakul aimatav tellisehunnik. Nurgeline kujutamisviis.
5717.de: A man over middle age standing with legs apart, right hand on hip, in a three-quarter turn to the right. The man has a wrinkled elongated face, a serious gaze directed straight ahead, dark hair combed straight back. Under the blue jacket a reddish shirt is visible, dark trousers, footwear. The upper part of the background is intense cobalt blue, at the bottom left a pile of bricks can be discerned. An angular manner of depiction.

5718.d: Maali keskel keskealine töömees rohekas ruudulises särgis, käised kääritud, käed rippu kõrval, sirgelt seismas. Mehel veidi imestunud ilme, pilk üles suunatud, peas barett. Taust ülalt intensiivne sinine, alt poolt roostepruun ehitusdetaile markeeriv. Kontuure rõhutav nurgeline kujutamisviis.
5718.de: In the centre of the painting a middle-aged workman in a greenish checked shirt, sleeves rolled up, arms hanging at his sides, standing upright. The man has a slightly astonished expression, gaze directed upward, a beret on his head. The background is intense blue from above, rust-brown below, marking construction details. An angular manner of depiction emphasising the contours.

5719.d: Noorepoolne pikliku näo, pisut peast eemal olevate kõrvadega tumedapäine mees seismas, rusikas käed rippu. Mehel otse suunatud pilk, pisut altkulmu pilk. Tumeda jaki hõlmade vahelt paistab punakas särk. Taust ülalt intensiivne koobaltsinine, alt virna kujutav. Kontuure rõhutav kujutamisviis.
5719.de: A youngish dark-haired man with an elongated face and ears standing slightly away from his head, standing with fists hanging at his sides. The man's gaze is directed straight ahead, slightly from under his brows. Between the lapels of his dark jacket a reddish shirt is visible. The background is intense cobalt blue above, below depicting a stack. A manner of depiction emphasising contours.

5747.d: Ülalt vaade koobaltsinisega kujutatud surnuaiale saledate mustade puutüvede ja beezikate teeradade mustriga. Ees paremal lillepärgadega kaetud kalmuküngas, tagapool kollakad  küünalde valgustäpid.
5747.de: A view from above of a cemetery depicted in cobalt blue with a pattern of slender black tree trunks and beige-toned paths. In front on the right a burial mound covered with flower wreaths, behind it yellowish points of candlelight.

5748.d: Tehase interjööris kaks seisvat meest: vasakpoolne tumedas rõivas
5748.de: In the factory interior two standing men: the one on the left in dark clothing

5843.d: Ees sügisene kartulipõld töölt tulevate inimestega, korvid täis. Tagapool põhuga kaetud kuhjad, pruunikad ja samblarohelised põllusiilud, majakesed veekogu ääres. Sünge taeva taustal kahe suitseva korstnaga massiivsed tehasehooned.
5843.de: In the foreground, an autumn potato field with people coming from work, baskets full. Behind, stacks covered with straw, brownish and moss-green field silos, small houses by a body of water. Against a gloomy sky, massive factory buildings with two smoking chimneys.

5844.d: Esiplaanil jõgi kõrge sillaga. Kahel pool kallastel majad abihoonetega, puud. Teisel pool silda tehasehooned paljude suitsevate korstnatega. Pruunikashallid toonid, jõuline pintslilöök.
5844.de: In the foreground a river with a high bridge. On both banks houses with outbuildings, trees. On the other side of the bridge factory buildings with many smoking chimneys. Brownish-gray tones, vigorous brushwork.

5845.d: Ees astmelise kaldaga kaiäärne, pardid vees ujumas. Vasakul neid jälgivad inimesed. Tagapool kai ääres kalapaatide rida, hulk rahvast tänaval hoonete taustal. Pruunikas, hallikad küllastunud toonid, kohati pahtliga maalitud.
5845.de: In front, a quay with a stepped bank, ducks swimming in the water. On the left people watching them. Further back, along the quay, a row of fishing boats, a crowd of people on the street against the background of buildings. Brownish, greyish saturated tones, in places painted with a palette knife.

5846.d: Suvine vaade jõele. Ees poolenisti vette uppunud paadisild kõrkjate vahel. Paremal kaldal tume metsatukk. Vasakul päikesest valgustatud kaldal puud, kaugemal kaldalagendikul hooned. Maaliline laad.
5846.de: Summer view of a river. In front a boat landing half-sunk in water among sedges. On the right bank a dark patch of forest. On the left bank, lit by the sun, trees, further away on the clearing by the bank buildings. Painterly style.

5851.d: Esiplaanil keskel oja, millest paremal jupike männimetsa. Ojast vasakul põllulapid ja heinamaa. Taamal üksikud majad, millede taga metsamassiiv. Ülal sinine taevas. Maalitud erivärvilisi pintslilööke mõjuda lastes. Koloriit rohelistes, sinistes ja punastes toonides.
5851.de: In the foreground centre a stream, to the right of which a patch of pine forest. To the left of the stream fields and a meadow. In the distance solitary houses, behind which a forest mass. Above a blue sky. Painted letting varicoloured brushstrokes take effect. Colouring in green, blue and red tones.

5858.d: Kalapaat kolme mehega. Neist kaks võrke välja tõmbamas, üks aerutamas.
5858.de: A fishing boat with three men. Two of them pulling out nets, one rowing.

5859.d: Esiplaanil kõrgendikul männid, tagapool metsad ja järveserv, taevas pilved.
5859.de: In the foreground, pines on a rise, forests and the lakeshore behind, clouds in the sky.

5860.d: Esiplaanil liivane nõlvak üksikute puuvõsudega. Vasakul rohupuhmad. Tagaplaanil tumeroheliste mändidega kaetud madalad künkad. Vasakul peale mändide mõned kased. Taevas kollakates-lillakates toonides.
5860.de: In the foreground a sandy slope with solitary shrubs. On the left tufts of grass. In the background low hills covered with dark green pines. On the left, beyond the pines, a few birches. Sky in yellowish-purplish tones.

5896.d: Pastelsetes toonides sfäärilised kujundid mustja lõikejoone ja -pinnaga ruumilise mõjuga kompositsiooniks põimitud. Vasakus ülemises neljandikus, aimataval silmapiiril punaka viilkatusega hele maja perspektiivis nähtuna.
5896.de: Spherical forms in pastel tones interwoven into a composition with a spatial effect through blackish cutting lines and surfaces. In the upper left quarter, on a discernible horizon, a bright house with a reddish gable roof is seen in perspective.

5899.d: Stiliseeritud kupliline maastik veekoguga paremal, vasakul katusevill, üksikud arvatavad puud. Küpsed kollakaspruunid, roosakad, sinakasrohelised sfäärilised ja koonilised vormid põimuvad üksteisega.
5899.de: Stylised domed landscape with a body of water on the right, on the left a roof ridge, a few presumed trees. Ripe yellowish-brown, pinkish, bluish-green spherical and conical forms intertwine with one another.

5903.d: Kumeratest, otsekui kerast väljalõigatud tükkidest koosnev abstraktne kompositsioon. Valdavalt lillades, punastes ja kollastes toonides, otsekui hõõguvates värvides.
5903.de: Abstract composition consisting of curved pieces, as if cut out of a sphere. Predominantly in shades of purple, red and yellow, as if in glowing colours.

5914.d: Üle kogu pildipinna majade viilkatused. Vasakul ülal servas paistab veekogu, kaldal kaks inimfiguuri. Kontuurid musta värviga tugevalt rõhutatud.
5914.de: Gabled rooftops of houses cover the entire picture surface. In the upper left corner a body of water is visible, with two human figures on the shore. Contours strongly emphasized with black colour.

5915.d: Kivine mererand kadakate ja murdunud puutüvega. Meri külmades rohelistes toonides.
5915.de: Rocky sea shore with junipers and a broken tree trunk. The sea in cold green tones.

5916.d: Heledapäine naine rohekassinises kleidis ja tumedapäine naine lillas kleidis vaatavad punasekaanelist ajakirja. Foon sinavates, rohekates ja kollakates toonides.
5916.de: A fair-haired woman in a greenish-blue dress and a dark-haired woman in a lilac dress are looking at a magazine with a red cover. The background in bluish, greenish and yellowish tones.

5917.d: Suvises maastikus kolm inimest raudteerööbaste juures. Esiplaanil naise ja mehe kolmveerand-figuurid en face, paremal naise figuur profiilis paremale.
5917.de: In a summer landscape three people near railway tracks. In the foreground three-quarter figures of a woman and a man en face, on the right a woman's figure in profile to the right.

5918.d: Tänava vaade üksikute jalakäijatega. Esiplaanil keskel tunkedes mees, elektripuuriga töötamas.
5918.de: A street view with a few pedestrians. In the foreground, in the center, a man in overalls working with an electric drill.

5919.d: Malelaua-ruudulisel põrandal ümmargune laud. Sellel kaks pudelit, vaas puuviljadega, valge riie ja üks apelsin.
5919.de: On a chessboard-patterned floor a round table. On it two bottles, a vase with fruit, a white cloth and an orange.

5920.d: Laual paremal pool valge kann, pudel, vaas ja kaks sidrunit. Vasakul heledal draperiil taldrik puuviljadega. Esemed musta kontuuriga piiratud.
5920.de: On the table on the right a white jug, bottle, vase and two lemons. On the left, on a light drapery, a plate with fruit. Objects outlined in black contour.

5921.d: Esiplaanil vasakul kaks laudseinale naelutatud kala, paremal laudhoone nurk. Keskelt paistab rand paatidega ja veekogu.
5921.de: In the foreground on the left two fish nailed to a plank wall, on the right the corner of a plank building. In the middle the shore with boats and a body of water is visible.

5922.d: Esiplaanil sinakas-rohekas virvendav veepind. Veepinnal paat kolme inimesega. Veekogu taga liivane rand majadega. Taamal mets. Üle metsa paistavad kolm kõrget suitsevat korstent ja paremal tööstushooned. Taevas sinine valgete pilvedega. Toonitatud kontuur.
5922.de: In the foreground a bluish-green shimmering water surface. On the water a boat with three people. Beyond the body of water a sandy shore with houses. In the distance a forest. Above the forest three tall smoking chimneys are visible and on the right industrial buildings. The sky is blue with white clouds. Tinted contour.

5952.d: Keskealise rohelises ülikonnas mehe kolmveerandfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule, nägu en face. Foonis rohekates, roosakates ja ruugetes toonides sein kolme aknaga.
5952.de: A three-quarter figure of a middle-aged man in a green suit, in a slight turn to the left, face en face. In the background, a wall with three windows in greenish, pinkish and brownish tones.

5953.d: Erksates toonides natüürmort avatud akna juures. Sinises vaasis kimp lilli, samas valge alustass apelsiniga.
5953.de: A still life in bright tones by an open window. A bouquet of flowers in a blue vase, next to it a white saucer with an orange.

5954.d: Keskaegse linna vaade kuldfoonil. Esiplaanil kaks ümarat puud ja tiiger.
5954.de: View of a medieval town on a golden background. In the foreground two round trees and a tiger.

5955.d: Suvine mererand õitsvate kibuvitsadega. Esiplaanil lillakas-sinises kleidis istuv naine, tema ees linal pudel, kruus ja keerusai.
5955.de: A summer seashore with blooming dog-roses. In the foreground a woman sitting in a purplish-blue dress, in front of her on a cloth a bottle, a mug and a twisted bun.

5956.d: Paljaste ülakehadega mehed töötamas. Eemal rohekaskollane lagendik ja punane linn.
5956.de: Bare-chested men at work. In the distance a greenish-yellow open area and a red town.

5957.d: Esiplaanil kollakas jopes otsevaates mees ja must koer. Taga paremal meri, vasakul lehtpuumets ja hooneid.
5957.de: In the foreground a man in a yellowish jacket in frontal view and a black dog. Behind on the right the sea, on the left deciduous forest and buildings.

5958.d: Nurk interjöörist valge linaga kaetud laua ja roosa tooliga. Laual vaas heledate lilledega, toidunõud, sidrun, tumeroheline pudel ja mingi roosakas ese.
5958.de: A corner of an interior with a table covered with a white cloth and a pink chair. On the table a vase with pale flowers, tableware, a lemon, a dark green bottle and some pinkish object.

5959.d: Sinakasrohelises husaaririietuses mees valge hobuse seljas. Paremal käsi rohelise maastikuga kulissi toetamas.
5959.de: A man in bluish-green hussar's dress on a white horse. On the right a hand supporting a wing with a green landscape.

5960.d: Heleda linaga kaetud laual valge veinikann, vaskne puuviljavaas, punakas purk ja kolm õuna.
5960.de: On a table covered with a light cloth, a white wine jug, a copper fruit bowl, a reddish jar and three apples.

5961.d: Punasel ja sinisel draperiil lamav naisakt. Vasakul sinine rippuv draperii. Paremal valge laud kausi ja puuviljadega. Fooniks kollakasroheline maastik.
5961.de: A female nude reclining on red and blue drapery. On the left a hanging blue drapery. On the right a white table with a bowl and fruit. Background a yellowish-green landscape.

5962.d: Punasel vaibal seisev naisakt otsevaates sinise interjööri taustal.
5962.de: Standing female nude in front view on a red carpet against a blue interior background.

5963.d: Esiplaanil heledas kleidis tumedapäise tütarlapse kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Tema taga intensiivsetes rohelistes toonides künklik maastik jõe ja maanteega.
5963.de: In the foreground a three-quarter figure, in direct view, of a dark-haired girl in a light-coloured dress. Behind her a hilly landscape in intense green tones with a river and a road.

5964.d: Istuva, sinises kleidis pruunijuukselise tüdruku kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Foonis rohekates toonides interjöör. Läbi vasakul astuva ukse avaneb vaade kollastes toonides maastikul.
5964.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated brown-haired girl in a blue dress, in frontal view. In the background an interior in greenish tones. Through a door opening on the left a view onto a landscape in yellow tones opens up.

5965.d: Nuppudega puuvoodis kollakal draperiil lamav naisakt. Taamal maastikuvaade roosakates toonides veekoguga.
5965.de: A female nude lying on a yellowish drapery in a wooden bed with knobs. In the distance a landscape view with a body of water in pinkish tones.

5969.d: Valgel riidel esiplaanil valge kõrvaga kann, kahe punase amarüllisega. Samas kõrval rohelised õunad. Tagapool valge paber.
5969.de: On white cloth in the foreground a jug with a white handle, with two red amaryllises. Next to it green apples. White paper in the background.

5972.d: Akna alla istuva prillidega vanema naise rinnaportree, kerges pöördes vasakule. Seljas eest nööbitav pruun kampsun. Näos tugevad kortsud. Vasakusse serva jääb potis kasvav toataim. Aknast paistavad õitsvad viljapuud.
5972.de: Bust portrait of an elderly woman wearing glasses, sitting below a window, in a slight turn to the left. Wearing a brown cardigan buttoned at the front. Strong wrinkles on the face. In the left edge a potted houseplant. Blossoming fruit trees are visible through the window.

5973.d: Esiplaanil heledal alusel kuldne kauss mitmevärviliste puuviljadega. Taustaks oranžikais-punastes toonides maastik.
5973.de: In the foreground, on a light-coloured stand, a golden bowl with multicoloured fruits. Background a landscape in orangish-red tones.

5974.d: Pildil esiplaanil neli erivärvilist kohvitassi ning kaks potilille, vasakpoolne valgete, parempoolne punaste õitega.
5974.de: In the foreground of the picture four coffee cups of different colours and two potted flowers, the left one with white blossoms, the right one with red blossoms.

5975.d: Esiplaanil valge riidega kaetud laud, millel paremal vasakul vaas kirjude astritega. Tagaplaanil, üle kogu pildipinna rohelistes toonides kattel lamav ookerja kehatooniga naisakt, nägu ärapööratud.
5975.de: In the foreground a table covered with a white cloth, on which, on the right and left, a vase with colourful asters. In the background, across the whole picture surface, on a green-toned blanket lies an ochre-toned female nude, her face turned away.

5976.d: Pruunikas ovaalis esiplaanil üks istuv mees-ja naisfiguur. Nende taga keskel kaks seisvat meesfiguuri ning üks naisfiguur. All paremal nurgas teekann ja tassid, vasakul kauss puuviljadega. Ülal valge draperii ja mitmevärvilised lilled.
5976.de: In a brownish oval, in the foreground one seated male and one female figure. Behind them in the middle two standing male figures and one female figure. Lower right corner a teapot and cups, on the left a bowl with fruit. Above, a white drapery and multicoloured flowers.

5989.d: Keskel neljakandilise laua nurgal istub noor kätega lauale toetuv punaste paksude paažisoengus juustega naine, tukk silmil. Otsevaates naise on seljas lühikeste varrukatega erkroosa pluus ning rohekassinised retuusid. All foonil sinised, rahutud, nagu keerlevad pinnad. Keskjoonest kõrgemal soojades ookerjates, roheliste ja kollastes toonides kaarja pinnad.
5989.de: In the middle, at the corner of a square table, sits a young woman with hands resting on the table, with thick red hair in a pageboy cut, fringe over the eyes. In frontal view the woman wears a bright pink short-sleeved blouse and greenish-blue tights. In the background below, blue, restless, swirling-like surfaces. Above the middle line, arched surfaces in warm ochre, green and yellow tones.

5990.d: Pildi keskel mererannal pikk kalamõrd pruunikates toonides. Esiplaanil hallil liivaluitel kuus roosakaspruuni  merepoid. Pildi keskjoonest kõrgemal sinakashall kergelt lainetav meri, paremal veepiiril pruun kast. Ülal roosakasvalgete rünkpilvedega taevas.
5990.de: In the middle of the picture, on a seashore, a long fish trap in brownish tones. In the foreground on a grey sand dune six pinkish-brown seals. Above the centre line of the picture a bluish-grey slightly rippling sea, on the right at the waterline a brown box. Above, a sky with pinkish-white cumulus clouds.

6019.d: Noore naise otsevaates rinnaportree - nägu ja kael heledad, dekolteeritud pluus kollane. Foon tumedates toonides.
6019.de: Frontal bust portrait of a young woman - face and neck light, décolleté blouse yellow. Background in dark tones.

6021.d: Väikese tüdruku portree istuvas asendis, frontaalselt, käed kõrval, kroon peas. Maalitud rahututes roosakas-rohelistes toonides, helepunaste sukkadega.
6021.de: Portrait of a little girl in a seated position, frontal, arms at her sides, a crown on her head. Painted in restless pinkish-green tones, with light red stockings.

6022.d: Suures plaanis talunaise poolfiguur, peas tume rätik, helepruuni kraega jakk eest avatud. Taustaks lumised katused, üksikud raagus puud ja kaugusesse suunduv teekäänak.
6022.de: Large-scale half-figure of a peasant woman, a dark headscarf on her head, a jacket with a light brown collar open in front. Background of snowy roofs, solitary bare trees, and a road bend leading into the distance.

6024.d: Puude vahel Ruhnu vana puukirik torniga vasakul. Esiplaanil kiviaed värava ja vanade ristidega kiriku ees.
6024.de: Among trees the old wooden church of Ruhnu with the tower on the left. In the foreground a stone wall with a gate and old crosses in front of the church.

6029.d: Seisva täidlase ja punapõskse mehe poolfiguur otsevaates. Riietus pruunides, foon sinistes, punastes, kollastes ja pruunides toonides.
6029.de: Half-figure of a standing, stout, red-cheeked man in frontal view. Clothing in brown tones, background in blue, red, yellow and brown tones.

6030.d: Intensiivsetes sinistes toonides sõõrjas laht. Selle ümber kahvatulillad ja punakaslillad mäed.
6030.de: A round bay in intense blue tones. Surrounded by pale lilac and reddish-lilac mountains.

6031.d: Vana, prillidega, hallide juuste ja vuntsidega mees otsevaates istumas. Foon rohelistes, sinistes ja kollastes toonides.
6031.de: An old man with glasses, grey hair and a moustache, sitting in a frontal view. Background in green, blue and yellow tones.

6032.d: Istuva vana mehe poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Maalitud õrnades sinakas-hallides toonides.
6032.de: Half-figure of a seated old man in a slight turn to the left. Painted in delicate bluish-grey tones.

6033.d: Esiplaanil istuv otsevaates figuur, käed silmade ees. Taga paremal istuv figuur profiilis paremale. Toonides sinakad, punakad ja pruunjashallid künkad, milledel kulgevad heledad teerajad.
6033.de: In the foreground a seated figure in front view, hands in front of the eyes. Behind on the right a seated figure in profile facing right. In tones of bluish, reddish and brownish-grey hills, on which run light paths.

6035.d: Naerunäolise, valkjashallis kleidis tütarlapse rinnaportree otsevaates.
6035.de: Frontal bust portrait of a smiling girl in a whitish-grey dress.

6038.d: Esiplaanil ja foonil sinised ning rohelised mäed, nende vahel sinakasvalge veekogu.
6038.de: Blue and green mountains in the foreground and background, between them a bluish-white body of water.

6039.d: Punane taevas, rohelise laiguga vasakul nurgas. Esiplaanil punakas-pruunid, tagaplaanil lillad künkad. Läbi küngaste punane laineline joon, suunaga alt ülesse.
6039.de: Red sky, with a green patch in the left corner. In the foreground reddish-brown, in the background purple hills. A red wavy line runs through the hills, directed from bottom to top.

6041.d: Kollakasrohelise maastiku ja sinise taeva taustal tugeva kehaehitusega, nurgelise, tugevajoonelise näoga keskealise mehe kolmveerandiguur. Juuksed pruunid, ülepea kammitud; suured, veidi aukus silmad; kitsaste huultega suur suu. Seljas pruun ülikond. Maalil kontuurid hajuvad.
6041.de: Against a background of yellowish-green landscape and blue sky, a three-quarter figure of a strongly built, middle-aged man with an angular, strong-featured face. Brown hair, combed back over the head; large, slightly sunken eyes; a large mouth with narrow lips. He wears a brown suit. In the painting, the contours dissolve.

6043.d: Üle kogu pildipinna horisontaalsete värvilaikudega edasi antud merepind (sinised, rohelised, valged ja punased toonid). Ülaservas sinakashall taevariba, allservas kitsuke maariba ja väike O-kujuline joon.
6043.de: Over the entire picture surface, a sea surface rendered with horizontal patches of colour (blue, green, white and red tones). At the top edge a bluish-grey strip of sky, at the bottom edge a narrow strip of land and a small O-shaped line.

6055.d: Heledate lühikeste juuste, tumesiniste silmadega heledaverelise tütarlapse portree veerandpöördes vasakule. Seljas sinistes toonides kraeta kleit. Foon sinakashallides toonides, maalitud selgelt eraldatavate pikkade pintslilöökidega.
6055.de: Portrait of a fair-haired girl with short light hair and dark blue eyes, in a three-quarter turn to the left. Wearing a collarless dress in blue tones. Background in bluish-grey tones, painted with clearly distinguishable long brushstrokes.

6060.d: Paljudest väikestest figuuridest ja figuurigruppidest koosnev figuraalne kompositsioon: horisontaalse keskjoone kohal liigub paremal vasakule ekstaasis inimeste rongkäik, esimesed kannavad istuvat kuju. Paremal ülaservas grupp põlvitavaid naisfiguure, vaimuliku või nunnaga nende ees püsti seismas. Vasakus servas ja all inimesed igapäevaste toimingute juures - voodis, tantsimas, võitlemas, vestlemas. Figuurid maalitud eskiislikult, valdavalt mustades, pruunides ja hallides toonides. Foonil domineerivad sinised ja roosakaspunased toonid.
6060.de: A figural composition consisting of many small figures and figure groups: above the horizontal centre line a procession of people in ecstasy moves from right to left, the first ones carrying a seated figure. In the upper right corner a group of kneeling female figures, with a clergyman or a nun standing in front of them. In the left margin and below, people are engaged in everyday activities - in bed, dancing, fighting, conversing. The figures are painted sketchily, predominantly in black, brown and grey tones. Blue and pinkish-red tones dominate in the background.

6073.d: Esiplaanil vasakul keskealise mehe rinnafiguur poolpöördes paremale. Seljas tume pintsak ja valge särk, peas tume soni. Taustaks viljapõld, eemal veekogu ja grupp punase katusega maju.
6073.de: In the foreground on the left, the chest figure of a middle-aged man in half-turn to the right. Wearing a dark jacket and white shirt, a dark hat on his head. Background a grain field, in the distance a body of water and a group of houses with red roofs.

6084.d: Istuva mehe kolmveerandfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Foon hele.
6084.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated man in a slight turn to the left. Background light.

6103.d: Vasakul nurgas taburett, millelt langeb põrandale eredates värvides kirju riie. Põrandal kauss õuntega, paremal üksik õun. Kausist paremal, kaugemal kaks kõrget vaasi. Taburetil kaks õuna ja vaas. Paremal pool fooniks sinine, tumesiniste täppidega draperii.
6103.de: In the left corner a stool from which a brightly coloured cloth falls to the floor. On the floor a bowl with apples, on the right a single apple. To the right of the bowl, further back, two tall vases. On the stool two apples and a vase. On the right side, the background is a blue drapery with dark blue dots.

6145.d: Esiplaanil otse vaataja suunas voolav kivine oja. Kahelpool kõrged kaldad ja raagus puud.
6145.de: In the foreground a stony brook flowing straight towards the viewer. On both sides high banks and bare trees.

6147.d: Avar vaade Lõuna-Eesti vooremaastikule: nõlvakud tumedate metsatukkadega, heledad põllud nende vahel, vasakul looklev tee. Taevas rahutuis rünkpilveis.
6147.de: Broad view of a South Estonian drumlin landscape: slopes with dark clumps of forest, light fields between them, on the left a winding road. Sky with restless cumulus clouds.

6151.d: Panoraamne maastik järvega, milles metsaga kaetud saared ja poolsaared.
6151.de: Panoramic landscape with a lake containing forested islands and peninsulas.

6187.d: Vaade kõrgemalt järveäärsele maastikule: ees majade katused, vasakule jääb helendav järv, tagapool nõlvakud metsaviirgudega. Sumedad toonid.
6187.de: View from above onto a lakeside landscape: in front the roofs of houses, to the left a glimmering lake, behind slopes with strips of forest. Soft tones.

6314.d: Mehe portree profiilis vasakule pingil istumas. Käed püksitaskus, peas barett. Foon hallikas-roheline.
6314.de: Portrait of a man in profile facing left, sitting on a bench. Hands in trouser pockets, a beret on his head. Background greyish-green.

6315.d: Mehe poolfiguur en face toetumas parema käega kruustangidele, vasak puusas. Pruunjad juuksed, valge särk, sinine kittel.
6315.de: Half-figure of a man en face, leaning with his right hand on a vice, left hand on his hip. Brownish hair, white shirt, blue smock.

6316.d: Prillidega keskealise mehe portree. Keha profiilis, nägu poolprofiilis paremale. Suus suits. Tume kuub, sinine särk.
6316.de: Portrait of a middle-aged man with glasses. Body in profile, face in half-profile to the right. Cigarette in mouth. Dark coat, blue shirt.

6318.d: Tütarlapse rinnaportree poolpöördes vasakule, heleda kraega sinises kleidis, tumedatel juustel väike kirju rätik.
6318.de: Bust portrait of a girl in half-turn to the left, in a blue dress with a light collar, a small patterned scarf on her dark hair.

6319.d: Tumedapäise, tumedas rõivastuses mehe rinnaportree kerges pöördes vasakule. Pilk suunatud alla, suus sigaret.
6319.de: Bust portrait of a dark-haired man in dark clothing, in a slight turn to the left. Gaze directed downward, a cigarette in his mouth.

6356.d: Esiplaanil lage väli, tagaplaanil kõrged tehasehooned, millede poole suundub esiplaanilt paremalt autode kolonn.
6356.de: In the foreground an open field, in the background tall factory buildings, towards which a column of cars moves from the right foreground.

6357.d: Talvine tehasevaade. Paremal kõrge hoone ja kaks suitsevat korstent. Keskel balastik ja hooneid, vasakul kõrge tornitaoline maja ja vedur.
6357.de: Winter view of a factory. On the right a tall building and two smoking chimneys. In the centre a ballast area and buildings, on the left a tall tower-like building and a locomotive.

6406.d: Esiplaanil ookerkollasel valges trikoos lamav, seljaga seljatoele toetuv päevitunud naine valge teravaninalise kingaga jalas, pooleksmurtud kirjaga käes, vasaku küljega vaataja poole. Tema jalgade juures ümmargune laud kolme puuviljaga. Seljataga meri, vasakus ülemises nurgas taamal ehitis. Lillakassinine taevas.
6406.de: In the foreground a suntanned woman lying on ochre-yellow, wearing white tights, leaning back against the backrest, with a white pointed-toe shoe on her foot, holding a half-folded letter, her left side towards the viewer. At her feet a round table with three pieces of fruit. Behind her the sea, in the upper left corner a building further away. Purplish-blue sky.

6407.d: Kirevatest värvilaikudest moodustatud foonil grupp noori inimesi, kellede keskele jääb valges särgis vanema mehe poolfiguur.
6407.de: On a background formed of colourful patches, a group of young people, in the middle of whom is the half-figure of an older man in a white shirt.

6412.d: Esiplaanil taluaed õitemeres õunapuudega. Muruga kaetud puudealune, mida servab mulkudega lattidest aed. Aia taga telliskivipunane valge katusega väike maja, paremal servas tagapool samasugune kuur. Puude kohal erksinine pilvitu taevas.
6412.de: In the foreground a farm garden in a sea of blossoms with apple trees. Grass-covered ground beneath the trees, bordered by a fence of slatted boards with gaps. Behind the fence a small brick-red house with a white roof, on the right further back a similar shed. Above the trees a bright blue cloudless sky.

6434.d: Avaral aknalaual vaas lilledega ja pintsleid. Vasakul jalgadega maalikast, palett ja kirju draperii. Aknast vaade talvisele linnale.
6434.de: A vase with flowers and brushes on a spacious windowsill. On the left a paint box with legs, a palette and a colourful drapery. View from the window of a wintry city.

6435.d: Esiplaanil laual potilill, virn raamatuid ja vaas kollaste lilledega. Taga laual kirju riie ja raamatuid.
6435.de: In the foreground on a table a potted plant, a stack of books and a vase with yellow flowers. Behind, on a table, patterned cloth and books.

6438.d: Künklik maastik. Esiplaanil kollakates-rohekates toonides põllud, üksikud puudegrupid. Keskplaanil vasakul järv. Vasakul ja paremal hooneid. Taamal mets.
6438.de: Hilly landscape. In the foreground, fields in yellowish-greenish tones, isolated groups of trees. In the middle ground on the left, a lake. Buildings on the left and right. Forest in the background.

6439.d: Esiplaanil vasakul sinine valgete täppidega vaas kollaste iiristega, keskel klaasnõu paremal õunad. Taga vasakul lillakas-sinine draperii, paremal aken.
6439.de: In the foreground on the left a blue vase with white dots and yellow irises, in the middle a glass vessel, apples on the right. Behind on the left a lilac-blue drapery, on the right a window.

6440.d: Lumine maastik. Esiplaanil vasakul kaugusse viiv tee, mille ääres vasakul hooneid ja mõned puud, paremal puudetukk.
6440.de: Snowy landscape. In the foreground on the left a road leading into the distance, with buildings and a few trees along it on the left, a clump of trees on the right.

6441.d: Lõuna-Eesti maastik laias orus kulgeva teega. Vasakul ja paremal metsaga kaetud mäed.
6441.de: South Estonian landscape with a road running through a wide valley. On the left and right, forest-covered hills.

6451.d: Esiplaanil kalda ääres kaks suuremat ja üks väiksem kalapaat. Väiksema juures kaks meest sillal võrke paadist välja võtmas. Taga meri, üksikute rünkpilvedega taevas, vasakul maariba.
6451.de: In the foreground by the shore two larger and one smaller fishing boat. By the smaller one two men on a bridge taking nets out of the boat. Behind, the sea, a sky with scattered cumulus clouds, a strip of land on the left.

6452.d: Esiplaanil lauanurk ja lai aknalaud, milledel vaasid lilledega, kaktused, mõned raamatud. Aknast vaade õhtusele Võidu väljakule. Otse akna all raagus puud.
6452.de: In the foreground a corner of a table and a wide windowsill, on which vases with flowers, cacti, some books. From the window a view of the evening Võidu Square. Directly below the window, bare trees.

6453.d: Paremal esiplaanil laev kai ääres. Vasakul ja taga hulgaliselt laevu.
6453.de: A ship at the quay in the right foreground. Numerous ships on the left and in the background.

6454.d: Talvine linnavaade: allservast pildi sühavusse suunduv tänav, millest kahel pool, diagonaalselt kõrged uued majad; tahapoole jääb Toompea ja teised tornid.
6454.de: Winter cityscape: a street leading from the lower edge into the depth of the picture, on both sides of which, diagonally, tall new buildings; behind, Toompea and other towers.

6455.d: Vaade linnamüürile Nunnatorni ja Kuldjala torni vahelisel alal. Selle tagant paistavad Oleviste ja Issanda-muutmise kiriku tornid. Esiplaanil jalakäijad.
6455.de: View of the town wall in the area between the Nuns' Tower and the Golden Foot Tower. Behind it, the towers of St. Olaf's Church and the Church of the Transfiguration can be seen. Pedestrians in the foreground.

6456.d: Paremal kai ääres suur laev ja hulganisti väiksemaid. Vasakul meri.
6456.de: On the right by the quay a large ship and many smaller ones. On the left the sea.

6462.d: Suvine vaade sadamale. Esiplaanil kai ääres kalalaevad. Taga, kõrgemal kaldal elumajad. Hoogne maaliline laad.
6462.de: A summer view of a harbour. In the foreground fishing boats by the quay. Behind, on higher ground, dwelling houses. A vigorous, painterly style.

6471.d: Esiplaanil järv, mille paremalt kaldalt ulatub sügavale (maali keskossa) metsaga kaetud maariba. Tagapool Lõuna-Eesti künklik maastik metsatukkade ja lookleva teega.
6471.de: In the foreground a lake, from whose right bank a strip of land covered with forest reaches deep (into the centre of the painting). Behind it the hilly landscape of South Estonia with clumps of forest and a winding road.

6475.d: Hallikassinise sünge taeva all künklik maastik mäeseljakute ja puude-põõsaste puhmastega. Keskel looklev oja kaugeneb puudemasside vahele. Summutatud hallikad värvikooskõlad, hoogne maalilaad.
