8099.d: Kollastes ja rohelistes toonides lõunamaa maastik: keskplaanis paremal hele, madala katuse, rõdude ja kaaruksega maja. Maja ees antiikajast samba ülaosa. Maja taga järv või lahesopp, mille kallastelt tõusevad silmapiirile madalad mäed. Ülanurgas paremal on näha osa majast, vasakul keskplaanil hulk siredaid küpresse ja akvedukti varemed.
8099.de: A southern landscape in yellow and green tones: in the middle ground on the right a bright house with a low roof, balconies and an arcade. In front of the house the upper part of an antique column. Behind the house a lake or bay, from whose shores low mountains rise to the horizon. In the upper right corner part of a house is visible, on the left in the middle ground a number of slender cypresses and the ruins of an aqueduct.

8149.d: Heledapäise, punases-lillas riietuses noormehe poolfiguur otsevaates. Foon punakas.
8149.de: Half-figure of a fair-haired young man in red-purple clothing, frontal view. Background reddish.

8179.d: Tumedajuukselise, sinises kleidis tütarlapse rinnafiguur kerges pöördes paremale. Pruunid silmad, tugev nina, täidlane suu.
8179.de: The bust of a dark-haired girl in a blue dress in a slight turn to the right. Brown eyes, a strong nose, a full mouth.

8180.d: Istuva vanema naise kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates, käed süles. Riietatud setu rahvarõivaisse. Rohekaspruun foon.
8180.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated elderly woman in frontal view, hands in her lap. Dressed in Setu folk costume. Greenish-brown background.

8182.d: Noore mehe rinnapilt otsevaates, nägu ja kael maalitud telliskivi-punases toonis. Vasakul õlal hoiab puuri, peas sonimüts. Fooniks ehitusplats.
8182.de: Frontal chest-length portrait of a young man, face and neck painted in brick-red tone. He holds a cage on his left shoulder, wearing a sonimüts [knit cap] on his head. Background is a construction site.

8197.d: Rohtunud ja puudesse kasvanud kallastega jõgi, kaugemal sillakaar. Esiplaanil kaks last, vasakul purre, mille ääres paate ja inimesi.
8197.de: A river with grassy, tree-grown banks, in the distance the arch of a bridge. In the foreground two children, on the left a footbridge, by which boats and people.

8206.d: Üle pildi pinna suures plaanis kolm meest kannavad õlal tala, suund paremale.(eesti)
8206.de: Across the picture surface, in close view, three men carry a beam on their shoulders, moving to the right.

8207.d: Vanema naise portree otsevaates, peas tume barett, kaelas sall, jakihõlmad avatud.(eesti)
8207.de: Portrait of an older woman in frontal view, wearing a dark beret, a scarf around the neck, jacket flaps open.

8212.d: Külmsinises lahesopis punakaspruune laevu, kaldad tõusevad kõrgeteks jäämägedeks, foonilt lillakad.(eesti)
8212.de: In a cold blue bay, reddish-brown ships, the shores rise into high icebergs, purplish against the background.

8217.d: Erksinistes ja punastes toonides kompositsioon. Keskel kolm punast inimfiguuri teravatipulistes mütsides.
8217.de: Composition in bright blue and red tones. In the middle three red human figures in pointed caps.

8229.d: Talvine maastik kadakate ja tuulikutega, abstraheeritud vormides. Rajatud siniste toonide ja valge kontrastile, kuu kollakas.
8229.de: A winter landscape with junipers and windmills, in abstracted forms. Built on the contrast of blue tones and white, the moon yellowish.

8255.d: Vaade Toompeale ja sinna viivale Lühikesele jalale Kullassepa tänavalt. Esiplaanil vasakul grupp raagus puid ja E. Vilde mälestusmärk.
8255.de: View of Toompea and the Short Leg leading to it, from Kullassepa Street. In the foreground on the left a group of bare trees and the E. Vilde monument.

8259.d: Sinistes toonides maalitud alusele kinnitatud mitmesuguseid, erinevatest materjalidest, ruumilisi esemeid, mis katavad tihedalt aluspinda. Ülemisel poolel, vasakul, nelinurksel puutahvlil metallplaat, millel lilleõiekujuliselt sisselõiked, samas plastmassist pudelikork. Ülal keskel metallist kinnise küljes liikuv, soontega, 19,7 cm pikkune ora. Ülal paremas kõrvuti kaks robustset puulusikat, värvitud puust rattaid, koltse. Alumisel poolel, vasakul, metalliribadest keeratud, azuurseid kujundeid. Paremal all fooliumi foonil traadist ümmargune, lame karkass. Paremal keskel puust kuubik arvuga "7". Alt vasakult üles paremale kaks paralleelset, puust riba, mis moodustavad sinisepõhjalise kanali.(
8259.de: Various three-dimensional objects made of different materials are attached to a base painted in blue tones, densely covering the base surface. In the upper half, on the left, on a rectangular wooden panel, a metal plate with flower-shaped cutouts, and next to it a plastic bottle cap. At the top in the middle, a grooved awl 19.7 cm long, movable, attached to a metal fastening. At the top right, side by side, two rough wooden spoons, painted wooden wheels, cogwheels. In the lower half, on the left, azure-coloured shapes twisted from metal strips. At the bottom right, against a foil background, a round, flat wire frame. In the middle right, a wooden cube with the number "7". From the bottom left to the top right, two parallel wooden strips forming a blue-based channel.(

8268.d: Istuv naisefiguur. Käed asetatud risti sülle, pea pööratud veidi vasakule. Temast vasakul väike, kirju, lendav liblikas.(eesti)
8268.de: A seated female figure. Hands placed crossed in her lap, head turned slightly to the left. To her left a small, mottled, flying butterfly.

8274.d: Pikkade tumedate juustega punases kleidis tütarlapse poolfiguur profiilis vasakule.
8274.de: Half-figure of a girl with long dark hair in a red dress, in profile to the left.

8310.d: 60`aastate laadis kompositsioon stiliseeritud nelja inimfiguuriga. Kõik figuurid otsevaates ja täispikkuses. Keskel veidi lühem. Paremal serval seisva otsevaates figuuri pea on suunatud vasakule. Koloriidilt maalil domineerivad määrdunud pruunid, hallid, heledamad rohelised toonid. Helesinine värviaksent maali keskosas.
8310.de: A composition in the style of the 1960s with four stylised human figures. All figures are shown frontally and full-length. The middle one is a little shorter. The head of the frontal figure standing at the right edge is turned to the left. The colour scheme of the painting is dominated by dirty brown, grey and lighter green tones. A light blue colour accent in the middle part of the painting.

8343.d: Istuva tumedate poolpikkade juustega tütarlapse portree: seljas tumesinine seelik ja heledam sinine pullover. Käed süles risti, nägu profiilis. Foon sinine, kogu pilt tihedalt pintsliga läbi töötatud pintslilööke paista lastes.
8343.de: Portrait of a seated girl with dark medium-length hair: wearing a dark blue skirt and a lighter blue pullover. Hands crossed in her lap, face in profile. Background blue, the whole picture densely worked through with the brush, letting brushstrokes show.

8349.d: Künklik maapind. Keskplaanil väike lehtpuusalu. Maali pind faktuurne. Maastik maalitud rohelistes, pruunides ja kollastes toonides.(eesti)
8349.de: Hilly terrain. In the middle ground a small grove of deciduous trees. The surface of the painting is textured. The landscape is painted in green, brown and yellow tones.

8385.d: Ülaltvaade Tallinna vanalinna katustele ja kaugemal paistvale sadamale, lahele. Summutatud toonides, geometriseerivas laadis maal lähestikku asetsevate majade katuste, korstnate, müüride tahukatest, üks heledamalt valgustatud majasein paremal. Majade taga veepiiril paistab kraananokki, laevu reidil, kaugemal lahel kaks valget purje. Silmapiiril kaldatriip ja riba sinkjat taevast.
8385.de: A bird's-eye view of the roofs of Tallinn's Old Town and, further away, the visible harbour and bay. A painting in muted tones, in a geometrising style, of the closely placed cubic shapes of house roofs, chimneys, and walls, with one more brightly lit house wall on the right. Behind the houses, on the water's edge, crane booms and ships in the roadstead can be seen, further away on the bay two white sails. On the horizon a strip of shoreline and a band of bluish sky.

8420.d: Lillad ja roosad väikeste õitega pikavarrelised lilled hallis vaasis. Foon pruunikas.
8420.de: Purple and pink long-stemmed flowers with small blossoms in a gray vase. Background brownish.

8428.d: Tumedates toonides jõevaade suurte puudega kummalgi kaldal.
8428.de: A river view in dark tones with large trees on both banks.

8429.d: Ümmargusel laual valge-rohelise triibulisel taustal kaks pudelit, raamat, tuhatoos, klaas ja klaaskauss.
8429.de: On a round table against a white-green striped background, two bottles, a book, an ashtray, a glass and a glass bowl.

8441.d: Rohekates toonides tellingutega maastiku taustal punane kraana punasel alusel.(eesti)
8441.de: A red crane on a red base against a landscape background with scaffolding in greenish tones.

8452.d: Osa laevast. Esiplaanil neli meest võrke välja tõmbamas. Koloriit lillakas-rohekas-punakas.(eesti)
8452.de: Part of a ship. In the foreground four men pulling out nets. Colouring purplish-greenish-reddish.

8454.d: Laual mitmesuguse kujuga nõusid: paremal tumepruun kõrvaga kruus, kõrval veekann ja lillepott roheliste kitsaste lehtedega taim; vasakul madal kausike valge glasuuriga seestpoolt. Foonil vasakul roosat, paremal rohelist.
8454.de: On a table, vessels of various shapes: on the right a dark brown mug with a handle, next to it a water jug and a flower pot with a plant with narrow green leaves; on the left a low bowl with white glaze on the inside. In the background, pink on the left, green on the right.

8474.d: Esiplaanil paremal alasti mehe figuur heina niitmas. Tagaplaanil lamav naisakt ja põõsad. Mõlemad figuurid intensiivselt oranžid.
8474.de: In the foreground on the right the figure of a naked man mowing hay. In the background a reclining female nude and bushes. Both figures intensely orange.

8483.d: Hele kirikuhoone kuue sibulkupliga kõrgetel tambuuridel. Paremal neljatahuline kellatorn.
8483.de: A light-coloured church building with six onion domes on tall drums. On the right a four-sided bell tower.

8484.d: Punakaspruunis vaasis kaks suurt helekollast krüsanteemi.
8484.de: In a reddish-brown vase two large light-yellow chrysanthemums.

8495.d: Sinakas koloriidis foonil vaas kimbu pastellroosade roosidega.
8495.de: On a background in bluish colouring a vase with a bouquet of pastel pink roses.

8527.d: Osa tänavast majadegrupiga ääres. Esiplaanil vasakul hall madal ärklikorrusega maja, paremal kolmekorruseline kollane lameda katusega kivimaja. Üle majade katuste paistmas sügiseses värvitoonis puulatv. Taevas valkjas.
8527.de: Part of a street with a group of houses along it. In the foreground on the left a grey, low house with an attic storey, on the right a three-storey yellow stone house with a flat roof. Above the roofs of the houses a treetop in autumn colours is visible. The sky is whitish.

8640.d: Neli punastes sportpükstes mehefiguuri väljasirutatud kätega punast palli püüdmas.
8640.de: Four male figures in red sports trousers with outstretched arms catching a red ball.

8673.d: Tumedal, rohekal ja sinakasrohekal foonil lill kahe punase õiekobaraga pikkade varte otsas.
8673.de: Against a dark, greenish and bluish-green background, a flower with two red clusters of blossoms on long stems.

8674.d: Sombuse taevaga varakevadine maastik. Lumine esiplaan lage. Teisel plaanil tumedad metsatukad ja kaks lumise katusega maja. Tagaplaanil sinine riba (veekogu?). Taevas väga rahutu. Jõulised ja laiad pintslilöögid.
8674.de: Early-spring landscape with an overcast sky. Snowy bare foreground. In the second plane, dark patches of forest and two houses with snowy roofs. In the background a blue strip (a body of water?). The sky is very restless. Vigorous and broad brushstrokes.

8675.d: Kolm dekoratiivset kannu, korv ja kolm pudelit lillakas-pruuni ja halli kangaga kaetud alusel. Paremal nurgas tükk valkjat draperiid, vasakul paistab alusraamile kinnitatud lõuendi tagupool.
8675.de: Three decorative jugs, a basket and three bottles on a base covered with purplish-brown and grey fabric. In the right corner a piece of whitish drapery, on the left the reverse side of the canvas attached to the stretcher is visible.

8697.d: Toolil istuv mehe täisfiguur, parem jalg üle vasema, küünarnukid tooli käsipuudel, ilme tõsine, mõtlik. Foonil pikad pintslitõmbed, rõhutatud vertikaalseid jooni.(eesti)
8697.de: Full-length figure of a man sitting on a chair, right leg over the left, elbows on the armrests of the chair, expression serious, pensive. In the background long brush strokes, emphasised vertical lines.

8698.d: Istuva tüseda vanema mehe kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Lai äärega peakate, avatud kaelusega särk, roheline vest, rohekasbeež ülikond. Foon rohekais toonides.(eesti)
8698.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated, stout, elderly man in full-face view. A wide-brimmed headgear, a shirt with an open collar, a green waistcoat, a greenish-beige suit. Background in greenish tones.

8715.d: Peaaegu abstraktselt antud värvilaikude kombinatsioonina on esiplaanil sinises seelikus, kollases pluusis, rohelise näo ja lillakaspunaste juustega tütarlaps kitarri mängimas. Esiplaanil allservas mustaga joonistatud väljasirutatud käed. Keskplaani figuurist paremal ja vasakul aimub teisi tütarlapsi. Foon abstraktsete värvipindade kombinatsioon.
8715.de: As an almost abstract combination of colour patches, in the foreground a girl in a blue skirt, yellow blouse, with a green face and purplish-red hair is playing the guitar. In the lower foreground edge, outstretched hands drawn in black. To the right and left of the middle-ground figure, other girls can be sensed. The background is a combination of abstract colour surfaces.

8727.d: Kolm tumedapäise tütarlapse seisvat kolmveerandfiguuri - parempoolsel käed pea kohale tõstetud, vasakpoolsel vasak käsi juuste piiril, pilk maha suunatud; keskmisel figuuril vasak käsi vöö kõrgusel.
8727.de: Three standing three-quarter figures of dark-haired girls - the one on the right with hands raised above the head, the one on the left with left hand at the hairline, gaze directed downward; the middle figure with left hand at waist height.

8733.d: Mattides rohekais, lillakais ja pruunikais toonides külamaastik hoonete ja puudegruppidega. Taevas helesinine.
8733.de: A village landscape in muted greenish, purplish and brownish tones, with buildings and groups of trees. The sky is light blue.

8739.de: A bunch of colourful flowers on a patterned background.

8781.d: Viis spordirõivas jalgratturit maanteel vaataja suunas kihutamas. Tee ääres mustjaspruun põld. Üldistav maalilaad, figuurid tumeda kontuurjoonega ümbritsetud.
8781.de: Five cyclists in sportswear racing on a highway towards the viewer. Beside the road a blackish-brown field. Generalised painterly style, the figures outlined with a dark contour line.

8826.d: Esiplaanil punakal pinnal pundar üksteisest läbipõimunud rohelisi angerjaid. Tagaplaanil sinine veekogu selle kaldal kasvavate puudega ning roosa taevas. Värvipind faktuurne. Kontuurid rõhutatud.(eesti)
8826.de: In the foreground, on a reddish surface, a bundle of green eels intertwined with one another. In the background a blue body of water with trees growing on its shore and a pink sky. The paint surface textured. The contours emphasised.

8827.d: Laual natüürmort: kaks vaasi nelkidega, sinine taldrik, vaas, klaas, puuviljad ja raamat.
8827.de: Still life on a table: two vases with carnations, a blue plate, a vase, a glass, fruits and a book.

8833.d: Lillakal foonil kollane sõõr. Selles tilaga kell, millel inimese nägu.
8833.de: On a purplish background a yellow disc. In it a clock with a winding stem, on which there is a human face.

8858.d: Peaaegu abstraktselt mõjuvatest kujunditest koostatud kompositsioon: keskel mees hobuse seljas odaga esiplaanil lamavat sinist lohet tapmas. Foon meenutab maastikku, ülal väikeste pilvedega kaetud taevas. Mürgistes sinistes-lillades-rohelistes toonides, keskel horisontaalne erkpunane fooniosa.(eesti)
8858.de: A composition made up of almost abstractly rendered shapes: in the centre a man on horseback with a spear killing a blue dragon lying in the foreground. The background resembles a landscape, above a sky covered with small clouds. In poisonous blue-lilac-green tones, in the centre a horizontal bright red section of the background.

8887.d: Tumeda lõuahabemega, tumedas rõivastuses istuva mehe figuur, käed põlvede vahel. Foon tumepunane.
8887.de: Figure of a seated man with a dark chin beard, in dark clothing, hands between his knees. Background dark red.

8888.d: Istuva vanema mehe kolmveerandfiguur poolpöördes paremale. Hallid juuksed, prillid, sinine ülikond, hall vest, hele särk. Vasak käsi põlvedel, paremas ajakiri.
8888.de: Three-quarter figure of an older seated man, in a half-turn to the right. Grey hair, glasses, blue suit, grey vest, light shirt. Left hand on his knees, a magazine in his right.

8901.d: Sinisel toolil istuv noor naine profiilis vasakule. Kõrges soengus tumedad juuksed, hall seelik, kollane džemper.
8901.de: A young woman sitting on a blue chair, in profile facing left. Dark hair in a high hairstyle, grey skirt, yellow jumper.

8904.d: Keskealise, prillidega, tumesinises baretis ja mantlis mehe poolfiguur kerges pöördes vasakule. Foon oranž.
8904.de: The half-figure of a middle-aged man with glasses, in a dark blue beret and coat, slightly turned to the left. Orange background.

8915.d: Trellitatud avause taustal seisva mehe poolfiguur. Paremal peopesal sakilise servaga ese. All ääres sakiliste servadega ketaste riba.(eesti)
8915.de: Half-figure of a man standing against the background of a barred opening. On the right palm a jagged-edged object. Along the bottom edge a strip of jagged-edged discs.

8925.d: Viis ühenäolist noormeest lillakates särkides ja rohelistes pükstes paremalt vasemale jooksmas.(eesti)
8925.de: Five identical-faced young men in purplish shirts and green trousers running from right to left.

8931.d: Kollakais-punakais toonides kompositsioon sidrunkollase taeva foonil. Keskel neli meest ringis, kolm istumas, üks seismas. Nende ees hülged.(eesti)
8931.de: A composition in yellowish-reddish tones against a lemon-yellow sky background. In the middle four men in a circle, three sitting, one standing. In front of them, seals.

8943.d: Vaade sadamale hämaruses. Pildi ulatuses laevu, kraanasid, töölisi. Ees suures plaanis tööline, pilk ülespoole suunatud. Kauguses vasakul paistab Oleviste torn.
8943.de: View of the harbour at dusk. Ships, cranes, workers throughout the picture. In front, in large scale, a worker with gaze directed upward. In the distance on the left the tower of Oleviste is visible.

8944.d: Mustal foonil üks punakaspruun ja üks rohekas pudel ning kaks klaasi.
8944.de: One reddish-brown and one greenish bottle and two glasses on a black background.

8956.d: Paremal istuva, raamatut lugeva noore mehe kolmveerandfiguur. Vasakul noore naise istuv kolmveerandfiguur, nägu pöördes lugeja poole, pilk suunatud raamatusse; käed vabalt süles. Töö maalitud erksates oranžides toonides.
8956.de: A three-quarter figure of a young man sitting on the right, reading a book. On the left a three-quarter figure of a young woman sitting, her face turned toward the reader, her gaze directed at the book; hands resting loosely in her lap. The work is painted in vivid orange tones.

8959.d: Üle kogu pildi pinna vanalinna majade rägastik, vaatega ülalt katustelt. Ülal vasakus nurgas Vene katedraal, selle kõrval Niguliste äralõigatud torn.
8959.de: Across the whole surface of the picture a maze of old-town houses, viewed from above the rooftops. In the upper left corner the Russian cathedral, next to it the cut-off tower of Niguliste.

8961.d: Summutatud pruunides, rohelistes, kahkjas-kollastes ja sinakais toonides mets taeva taustal. Maalipind kergelt faktuurne.
8961.de: A muted forest in brown, green, pale-yellow and bluish tones against a sky background. The painted surface is slightly textured.

8962.d: Otsevaates tumedajuukselise, suurte tumedate silmadega noormehe portree. Seljas lahtise kaelusega valge särk. Maalitud piimjates toonides.
8962.de: Portrait of a young man with dark hair and large dark eyes, in frontal view. Wearing a white shirt with an open collar. Painted in milky tones.

8963.d: Abstraktsetest voolavatest kujunditest komponeeritud pilt mõnede vihjetega tegelikkusele: keskel sinine, tooli meenutav iste, millel rohelistes ja pruunides toonides "naiseks" nimetatud kujund. Foon allosas ookrikarva, ülal väikestest sinistest ja rohelistest rombidest koosnev.(eesti)
8963.de: A picture composed of abstract flowing shapes with some hints of reality: in the centre a blue seat resembling a chair, on which a shape called "the woman", in green and brown tones. The background at the bottom is ochre-coloured, above made up of small blue and green rhombi.

8982.d: Istuva mehe poolfiguur profiilis vasakule. Hele rohekas foon.
8982.de: Half-figure of a seated man in profile facing left. Light greenish background.

9017.d: Erksates värvides maastik. Veidi vasakul keskel väike valge, musta katusega maja. Sellest vasakul kolm elektriposti. Maali vasakus servas ning ka paremas sinakad madalad mäed. Eespool erkroheline küngas, millel hallikas teerada. Paremal järsk kallas ning veidi säravsinist merd. Esiplaanil punakas-roosa taimevaht, milles neli väiksemat hallides toonides kivi või tulpa. Taustaks kirgassinise-valge värvilahendusega pilvine taevas.
9017.de: A landscape in vivid colours. Slightly left of centre, a small white house with a black roof. To its left, three electricity poles. At the left edge of the painting and also at the right, bluish low mountains. In front, a bright green hill with a greyish path on it. At right, a steep bank and a bit of bright blue sea. In the foreground, reddish-pink plant foam, in which there are four smaller stones or tulips in grey tones. In the background, a cloudy sky in a bright blue-white colour scheme.

9055.d: Istuva naise põlvportree poolpöördes vasakule. Tumedad juuksed kuklasse kammitud, käed ristatult vasakule jalale toetatud. Seljas kinnise kaelusega tume kleit.
9055.de: Knee-length portrait of a seated woman in a half-turn to the left. Dark hair combed back into a bun, hands crossed and resting on the left leg. Wearing a dark dress with a closed collar.

9119.d: Kaks rohekas-halli potti roosakate hortensiatega pruunil foonil.
9119.de: Two greenish-grey pots with pinkish hydrangeas against a brown background.

9123.d: Sinise kleidi ja pikkade ruugete juustega istuva tüdruku kolmveerandfiguur otsevaates. Foon sinine.
9123.de: Three-quarter figure of a seated girl in a blue dress with long auburn hair, front view. Blue background.

9124.d: Poisikese kolmveerandfiguur en face toolil istumas, käed põlvede vahel. Seljas punakas kampsun ja roosa pluus, jalas rohelised püksid.
9124.de: Three-quarter figure of a boy sitting on a chair en face, hands between his knees. Wearing a reddish sweater and a pink blouse, green trousers.

9130.d: Mustas, pikas kleidis naine istub peegli ees, seljaga vaataja poole. Peeglilaual vaas punaste lilledega.
9130.de: A woman in a black, long dress sits in front of a mirror, her back to the viewer. On the dressing table a vase with red flowers.

9133.d: Paksu lumekihi all ees maapind, tajad taga, puud keskplaanil. Maalitud pastoosselt, laiade pintslilöökidega.
9133.de: Ground in the foreground under a thick layer of snow, distance behind, trees in the middle ground. Painted pastosely, with broad brushstrokes.

9142.d: Kirjul foonil vaas kolme roosa gladiooli ja hulga gladioolilehtedega.(eesti)
9142.de: On a patterned background a vase with three pink gladioli and a number of gladiolus leaves.

9143.d: Lillas ja pruunis riietuses mehe ja naise figuur ühise nimbuse all. Foon nende taga punane.(eesti)
9143.de: The figures of a man and a woman dressed in purple and brown under a shared halo. The background behind them red.

9149.d: Säravoranzi taevaga künklik maastik. Ees ja vasakul kuusemets, keskel lillakais toonides lagendik, selle taga sinakasrohekais - kollakais toonides riba. (eesti)
9149.de: A hilly landscape under a bright orange sky. In front and on the left a spruce forest, in the centre a clearing in lilac tones, behind it a strip in bluish-green – yellowish tones.

9150.d: Tõmmu, tumedate juustega ning habemega ja valges särgis mehe rinnafiguur. Esiplaanil ja foonil lilled. Maalitud väga pastoosselt.(eesti)
9150.de: Bust of a swarthy man with dark hair and beard, in a white shirt. Flowers in the foreground and background. Painted very pastosely.

9173.d: Kaks tütarlast ja kolm noormeest neljanurgelise laua ümber seismas või istumas. Maalitud kollakais ja punakais toonides, vaid äärmisel parempoolsel noormehel on smaragdrohelised püksid.
9173.de: Two girls and three young men standing or sitting around a four-cornered table. Painted in yellowish and reddish tones, only the young man on the far right has emerald green trousers.

9185.d: Kahel pool tänavat, mis suundub paremast servast maali sisse, madalad majad mändide all. Vasakpoolne telefonipost ristub tänavaga.
9185.de: On both sides of a street that leads into the painting from the right edge, low houses under pine trees. The telephone pole on the left crosses the street.

9187.d: Toolil istuva valges särgis mehe portree poolpöördes vasakule, käed põlvedele toetatud. Foon tumepruun.
9187.de: Portrait of a man in a white shirt sitting on a chair, in half-turn to the left, hands resting on his knees. Background dark brown.

9190.d: Vitstest punutud korvis kolm leekivpunaste õitega mooni. Foon tume.
9190.de: Three poppies with flaming red blossoms in a wicker basket. Dark background.

9204.de: A group of dark green pines on a snowy clearing.

9211.d: Rohelises kleidis naise põlveportree, käed süles, tumedad langevad juuksed (ülalt servaga lõigatud), punased pärlid kaelas.(eesti)
9211.de: Knee-length portrait of a woman in a green dress, hands in her lap, dark falling hair (cropped at the top edge), red beads around her neck.

9237.d: Rohekashalli rätiga kaetud sinisel laual paremal pealtvaates valge taldrik kolme kalaga. Vasakul külgvaates roheline pudel. Maalitud üldistavalt, suurte pindadena.
9237.de: On a blue table covered with a greenish-grey cloth, a white plate with three fish, seen from above on the right. On the left, a green bottle in side view. Painted in a generalized manner, in large areas.

9257.d: Pruunides toonides foonil samas gammas maalitud noore naise poolfiguur veerandpöördes vasakule. Naise nägu ja kaelaosa heledasti valgustatud, silmad maha löödud. Naisel lühikesed, tumedad, potina lõigatud juuksed, seljas tume, suure kollase mustriga riidest kleit. Foon, kaela- ja peaosa maalitud pastoosselt.
9257.de: Half-figure of a young woman painted in brown tones against a background in the same gamut, in a three-quarter turn to the left. The woman's face and neck brightly lit, eyes downcast. The woman has short, dark, pot-cut hair, wearing a dark dress of fabric with a large yellow pattern. The background, neck and head areas painted pastosely.

9270.d: Avar hallikas põld töötavate naistega. Esiplaanil kolm naist kõblastega vaataja suunas, vasakpoolne kummargil. Eemal vasakul figuure. Kollakashalli taeva all kauge silmapiir.
9270.de: A broad greyish field with women working. In the foreground three women with hoes facing the viewer, the one on the left bent over. Figures in the distance on the left. A distant horizon under a yellowish-grey sky.

9311.d: Kaks oranžides toonides maalitud naisakti - parempoolne lamab, vasakpoolne istub. Foon punakaskollane.
9311.de: Two female nudes painted in orange tones - the one on the right lying down, the one on the left sitting. Background reddish-yellow.

9312.d: Oranž-punaseis liibuvais rõivais, juukseid kammiva naise kolmveerandfiguur punasel foonil 3/4 pöördes vasakule.
9312.de: Three-quarter figure of a woman in orange-red close-fitting clothes, combing her hair, against a red background, in a 3/4 turn to the left.

9328.d: Allservas siniseks värvitud väikestest mänguasjadest (rattad, kõrinad, kuubikud, nukud, autod, liivavormid jne.) koostatud kompositsioon. Sellest kõrgemale on maalitud tume koobaltsinine meri, roosalt õhetav silmapiir ja sinakate lammaspilvedega kaetud taevas.(eesti)
9328.de: In the lower part a composition made of small toys (wheels, rattles, cubes, dolls, cars, sand moulds etc.) painted blue. Above it a dark cobalt-blue sea is painted, a pinkish glowing horizon, and a sky covered with bluish fleecy clouds.

9340.d: Vaade tehase õuele. All viis inimest sammumas vasakult paremale, ülal lahtisel platvormil rühm inimesi suundumas vasakul asuva trepi poole.
9340.de: View of a factory yard. Below, five people walking from left to right; above, on an open platform, a group of people heading towards a staircase on the left.

9349.d: 3/4 figuur istuvast mehest sinakal foonil pöördes vasakule. Käed põlvedel, pruunid püksid, valge särk.
9349.de: 3/4 figure of a seated man against a bluish background, turned to the left. Hands on knees, brown trousers, white shirt.

9354.d: Kirevavärvilise raamaturiiuli taustal istuvad üksteise vastas tugitoolidel kaks meest (E. Kits ja ?). Nende vahel ümmargusel laual raamatuid, pudel ja kohvitassid.
9354.de: Against a background of a colourful bookshelf, two men (E. Kits and ?) sit facing each other in armchairs. Between them, on a round table, books, a bottle and coffee cups.

9355.d: Lauale asetatud mitmesuguse kuju ja vormiga lillevaase: vasakul kõrge kitsas vaas kalladega, selle kõrval tumeda kõrvaga vaasis kuus suureõielist punast lille, tagapoolsetes roosades vaasides roose ja nelke, ees madal lai vaas ning vaatajale kõige lähemal vaas maikellukesi meenutavate kollakate lilledega. Vasakul pool foon tumedates, paremal heledates toonides.
9355.de: Flower vases of various shapes and forms placed on a table: on the left a tall narrow vase with calla lilies, next to it a vase with a dark handle containing six large-flowered red flowers, in the vases further back, pink ones with roses and carnations, in front a low wide vase, and closest to the viewer a vase with yellowish flowers resembling lilies of the valley. On the left the background is in dark tones, on the right in light tones.

9380.d: Esiplaanil laual hulk pintsleid, pudeleid, värvituube, tangid, ajaleht ja lõpetamata töid. Teos hallides, sinistes ja kollakas-pruunides toonides.
9380.de: In the foreground on a table a number of brushes, bottles, paint tubes, pliers, a newspaper and unfinished works. Work in grey, blue and yellowish-brown tones.

9398.d: Mehe põlvportree, kelle profiil paremale tuleb teravalt esile heldal foonil. Parem käsi taskus, vasak, sigaretti hoidev käsi, toetudb küünarvarrega kõrgemale alusele. Ülikond tumehall, särk sinine.
9398.de: Knee-length portrait of a man, whose profile facing right stands out sharply against a light background. Right hand in pocket, left hand, holding a cigarette, resting with the forearm on a higher stand. The suit is dark grey, the shirt blue.

9405.d: Õrnrohelisel, peenetriibulisel draperiil valge, punase triibuga vaas kirjude lilledega.
9405.de: On a light green, finely striped drapery a white vase with a red stripe and colourful flowers.

9408.d: Tähelise mustriga draperii foonil istuva tütarlapse täisfiguur. Parem käsi toetab järi, vasak lamab süles. Peas hall müts, seljas must džemper ja sinine seelik.(eesti)
9408.de: Full figure of a girl sitting against a background of drapery with a starry pattern. Right hand rests on a stool, left lies in her lap. On her head a grey cap, wearing a black sweater and a blue skirt.

9423.d: Vanade kivimüüride vahel, võlvitud avauses kaks figuuri: vasakul punases ääristatud rüüs ja sandaalides pooleldi kiilaspäine mees, pruun kott üle õla, vasak käsi paremal seisva tumedapäise poisikese õlal. Poiss hoiab käes anumat, tema kuue peal ümber õlgade suur punane rätik. Punakaspruunides ja rohelistes toonides.(eesti)
9423.de: Between old stone walls, in a vaulted opening, two figures: on the left a half-bald man in a red-trimmed robe and sandals, a brown bag over his shoulder, his left hand on the shoulder of a dark-haired boy standing to the right. The boy holds a vessel in his hands, a large red shawl draped around his shoulders over his coat. In reddish-brown and green tones.

9442.d: Toore liha värvi punakaspruunil alusel puust kübarategemise mannekeeni meenutav pea silmalohkude ja teravalt eenduva keskjoonega. Pea oliivikarva ja pruunides toonides, ümber valkjashall aurat meenutav ring. Abstraktsetest hallidest kujunditest komponeeritud foon.
9442.de: A wooden head resembling a hat-making mannequin, in the colour of raw meat, on a reddish-brown base, with eye sockets and a sharply protruding centre line. The head in olive and brown tones, surrounded by a whitish-grey ring resembling an aura. Background composed of abstract grey shapes.

9499.d: Trepil istuva noorema heledapäise mehe (Tõnu Mikiver) 3/4 figuur poolpöördes vasakule. Taustaks püramiidjalt paigutatud hallid trepid (redelid). Mehel seljas valge särk, roheline kuub, jalas pruunid püksid. Käed süles, toetumas vasakule reiele.
9499.de: 3/4-length figure of a younger fair-haired man (Tõnu Mikiver) sitting on a staircase, in a half-turn to the left. The background shows grey stairs (ladders) arranged in a pyramid shape. The man wears a white shirt, a green coat, and brown trousers. His hands rest in his lap, leaning on his left thigh.

9502.d: Esiplaanil rohelistes-sinistes toonides lehtedel grupp neljast kalu vardasse lükkivast tütarlapsest. Kaks neist põlvitavad maas. Tütarlaste taga suur kaluripaat, taamal paistab meri. Kaladel hõbepaberit.(eesti)
9502.de: In the foreground, on leaves in green-blue tones, a group of four girls skewering fish onto sticks. Two of them are kneeling on the ground. Behind the girls a large fishing boat, in the distance the sea is visible. The fish have silver paper on them.

9543.d: Intensiivsel sinisel foonil punases rõivastuses, punase baretiga mehe poolfiguur otsevaates, käes sigaret.
9543.de: Half-figure of a man in red clothing with a red beret against an intense blue background, in frontal view, holding a cigarette.

9562.de: Three-quarter figure of a laughing boy in an open doorway.

9581.de: A forest path, with a group of people in clear view.

9623.d: Kirevates toonides sügismaastik: esiplaanil söövad kolm musta-valgekirjut lehma, paremal ja vasakul erkkollastes ja -punastes lehtedes väikesed puud. Tagapool kolm majakest, üks neist, punane maja keskel, puude keskel. Ülal helesinine taevas valgete pilveräbalatega.(eesti)
9623.de: An autumn landscape in vivid tones: in the foreground three black-and-white cows grazing, on the right and left small trees with bright yellow and red leaves. Further back three little houses, one of them, a red house in the middle, among the trees. Above, a light blue sky with white cloud shreds.

9636.d: Grupp punaste viilkatustega maju, paremal osa Niguliste kirikust.
9636.de: A group of houses with red gable roofs, on the right part of the Niguliste church.

9756.d: Hallikas-sinise taeva all maastik valgete majadega ja kõrgete pruunikate korstnatega. Esiplaanil rohelise aasa keskel hall looklev tee. Tahakirjutused puuduvad.
9756.de: A landscape under a greyish-blue sky with white houses and tall brownish chimneys. In the foreground, in the middle of a green meadow, a grey winding road. No inscriptions on the back.

9765.d: Abstraktne värvikas kompositsioon: ülevalt valkjashallides, altpoolt lilla-ooker-kollastes toonides maalitud geometriseeritud kujundite fooni keskel saksakeelsetest ajakirjadest rebitud servadega paberkollaaž, pisut üle maalitud.
9765.de: Abstract colourful composition: in the middle of a background of geometricised shapes painted from above in whitish-grey and from below in purple-ochre-yellow tones, a paper collage with edges torn from German-language magazines, painted over slightly.

9768.d: Visand mererannast paremal kolm 3 puud. Tahakirjutused puuduvad
9768.de: Sketch of a seashore, on the right three 3 trees. No inscriptions on the back

9793.d: Erksavärviline popilik kompositsioon näiliselt šablooni järgi maalitud mehepeast, käsi lõua juures
9793.de: Vividly coloured pop-art-like composition of a man's head, apparently painted using a stencil, hand at the chin

9798.d: Sinistes toonides merevaade, alt üles perspektiivis kolmnurgaks moodustuv muul, millel esiplaanil 2 meest - vasakpoonlne vuntsidega, parempoolsel käed taskus. Paremal ülal 2 laeva.(eesti)
9798.de: Sea view in blue tones, from bottom to top in perspective a pier forming a triangle, on which in the foreground 2 men - the left one with a moustache, the right one with hands in pockets. Above right 2 ships.

9800.d: PÜHA SAMMAS Asukoht objektil: kiri taga alusraamil
9800.de: PÜHA SAMMAS Location on object: inscription on the back of the stretcher

9802.d: Pastoosne etüüdilik vaade lopsakale puule valge maja ees. Taevas kirkalt sinine.
9802.de: A pastose, sketch-like view of a lush tree in front of a white house. The sky is bright blue.

9807.d: Maali keskmes lakoonilises ja geomeetrilises stiilis pruun karussell sõitjatega, tagaplaanil suurte lindude puuride ees pealtvaatajad. Taustal roheline lehestikumassiiv sinise taeva all.
9807.de: In the centre of the painting, in a laconic and geometric style, a brown carousel with riders, in the background spectators in front of large bird cages. In the background a mass of green foliage under a blue sky.

9810.d: Keskmes heliplaat kirjaga "HIS MASTER'S VOICE", andmed plaadi kohta ja koera kujutis, kes kuulab grammafoni. Heliplaadist ulatub välja käelaba, mis osutab plaadi all olevat zhgutiga rusikasse surutud pulgaga käsivart, teine käelaba vasakul osutama samas suunas. Taustaks järvesilmadega kuppelmaastik ja taevas siniste pilvedega.(eesti)
9810.de: In the centre a record with the inscription "HIS MASTER'S VOICE", information about the record and an image of a dog listening to a gramophone. From the record a hand extends, pointing to an arm below the record clenched into a fist with a twisted cord and a stick, another hand on the left pointing in the same direction. In the background a domed landscape with lake eyes and a sky with blue clouds.

9816.d: Tumedates rohekates ja pruunikates toonides abstraktne interjöör, milles markeeritult sinised toolid ja inimfiguurid.(eesti)
9816.de: An abstract interior in dark greenish and brownish tones, with blue chairs and human figures marked in outline.

9821.d: Absurdipõhimõtteid jälgiv esemetemaal, mille kõikvõimalike metall-, puit-, riide- ja plastmass-osade vahelt leiame veel näiteks tumepunase mutri, ja selle poole lendava riideliblika, pudelikorgi, voodivedru, detailitäpsed putukajoonistused, ja võtme lukuta ukse avamiseks.
9821.de: A still life following the principles of absurdity, in which among all kinds of metal, wood, fabric and plastic parts we also find, for example, a dark red nut, and a fabric butterfly flying towards it, a bottle cork, a bed spring, insect drawings precise in detail, and a key for opening a door without a lock.

9822.d: Sinistest-punastest pindadest ulmeline ruum perspektiivis. Keskmes laua taga tõstetud kätega alasti naisfiguur, sinised laines juuksed lehvimas üle maali.
9822.de: A fantastical space made of blue-red planes, in perspective. At the center, behind a table, a nude female figure with raised arms, blue wavy hair fluttering across the painting.

9839.d: Optilistest geomeetrilistest kujunditest erksavärviline kompositsioon: koobaltsinise tausta keskel teravikest koosnev uduroosa rombi kujund, mida ääristavad roosa keskmega erkrohelised ringid illusoorselt kaugusse suundumas.
9839.de: A brightly coloured composition of optical geometric shapes: in the centre of a cobalt-blue background a hazy-pink rhombus form made up of points, bordered by bright green circles with pink centres, illusorily receding into the distance.

9843.d: Erksates oranžides, punastes, sinistes toonides ulmeline ruum, mis koondub keskmes helesinisesse ringi. Ülanurkades ja vasakus alumises neljandikus helesinised ruudud.
9843.de: In vivid orange, red, blue tones a fantastical space converging in the centre into a light blue circle. In the upper corners and the lower left quarter light blue squares.

9848.d: Sinistes toonides pilvise taeva ja lainetava mere taustal neli roosade nägudega kapuutsidega jopedes meest. (eesti)
9848.de: Against a background of a cloudy sky in blue tones and a rippling sea, four men in hooded jackets with pink faces.

9878.d: Lainelise horisontaaljoonega punaseks ja mustaks jaotuv, üleni värviga kaetud assamblaaž. Punasele osale kinnitatud värvitud puitklots, puitliist ja kaks ümmargust metallist tehnilist detaili. Mustale osale kinnitatud puitliist, puitklots, plastmassist tehniline detail, lusikas ja võti, mille rõngaava värvitud valgeks. Assamblaaži värvipind läikiv, kaetud ühtlaselt krakleega.
9878.de: An assemblage entirely covered with paint, divided by a wavy horizontal line into red and black. Attached to the red part a painted wooden block, a wooden batten and two round metal technical parts. Attached to the black part a wooden batten, a wooden block, a plastic technical part, a spoon and a key, whose ring opening is painted white. The painted surface of the assemblage is glossy, evenly covered with craquelure.

9901.d: Abstraheeritud figuuraalkompositsioon: paremal laua taga käsipõsakil prillidega kuju otsevaates. Vasakul kolm väiksemat kolmnurksetes peakatetes figuuri poolkülgvaates. Türkiisroheline, sinkjas koloriit, mustja kontuuriga tüüpe markeeriv laad.
9901.de: Abstracted figural composition: on the right, behind a table, a figure with glasses resting its cheek on its hand, seen frontally. On the left three smaller figures in triangular headgear, seen in half profile. Turquoise-green, bluish coloring, a manner marking the types with blackish contours.

9903.d: Erksavärviline (valdavalt sini-punane) abstraktne kompositsioon, mille allosa keskel neljakandiliseks jaotatud pindades mitmesugused tinglikud kujundid (liivakell, poolkaar, paberkollaaź jm) ja valge merekarp. Kirev pind ümbritsetud sinistes toonides lõikuvate kaarte, üksikute erkpunaste kujunditega.
9903.de: A brightly coloured (mainly blue-red) abstract composition, in the lower centre of which, in surfaces divided into quadrangles, various conventional shapes (hourglass, semicircle, paper collage, etc.) and a white seashell. The colourful surface is surrounded by intersecting arcs in blue tones, with isolated bright red shapes.

9904.d: Kirev abstraktne kompositsioon, mille alumisel poolel domineerivad sügavsinised, ülal punakad toonid, kõikvõimalikud erksavärvilised kujundid nende foonil.
9904.de: A colourful abstract composition, in the lower half of which deep blue tones dominate, above reddish tones, against their background all manner of brightly coloured shapes.

9905.d: Kompositsioon stiliseeritud kaladest. Punaka kahvatu tausta keskel lestakala, millel dekoratiivne männa-kujund oranži kettaga keskel. Paremal kaks, vasakul üks pisem kala. Allosas aimatav tume taimestik.
9905.de: Composition of stylized fish. In the middle of a reddish pale background a flatfish, bearing a decorative pine-shape figure with an orange disc in the center. On the right two, on the left one smaller fish. At the bottom, dark vegetation is discernible.

9906.d: Roosades, lillades ja sinistes toonides mäed. Kontuurid hajuvad. Ülal servas valge pilveriba.
9906.de: Mountains in pink, purple and blue tones. The contours are blurred. At the top edge a white strip of cloud.

9916.d: Poolabstraktne kompositsioon nelja autos istuva figuuriga. Figuurid deformeeritud orgaanilisele elule viitavas sürrealistlikus laadis. Üleval keskel markeeritud auto tagaaken, all paremal autorool, kogu kompositsioon punastes ja kollastes toonides.
9916.de: Semi-abstract composition with four figures seated in a car. The figures are deformed in a surrealist style suggesting organic life. At the top centre a marked rear window of the car, at the bottom right the car's steering wheel, the whole composition in red and yellow tones.

9918.d: Suitsuse tähistaeva all kooniliste kuuskedega metsaveerel, lagendiku keskel lõõmava lõkke ümber pinkidel ja maas istuvad inimesed, õllekapad käes. Tulekuma figuuridel ja selle tekitatud varjud vaataja suunas. Vasakul tagapool inimhulk lõõtspilli saatel tantsimas. Paremal puude all rohelise kastiga veoauto PX-8-02 ja väiksemaid sõidukeid. Stiliseeritud vormidega selgepiiriline kujutamisviis. Valdavalt samblarohelised, oliivtoonid, erksinine taevakaar.
9918.de: Under a smoky starry sky at the edge of a forest with conical spruces, in the middle of a clearing around a blazing bonfire, people sit on benches and on the ground, holding beer mugs. The glow of the fire falls on the figures and casts shadows toward the viewer. On the left, further back, a crowd of people dancing to the accompaniment of an accordion. On the right, under the trees, a truck with a green box, PX-8-02, and smaller vehicles. A clearly outlined manner of depiction with stylised forms. Predominantly moss-green, olive tones, a bright blue arc of sky.

9925.d: Kollasel taustal habemega vana mehe portree poolprofiilis paremale. Maalitud õrnalt geometriseerivas üldistuses, kohati pastoosselt, viimistletud pahtliga.
9925.de: Portrait of a bearded old man against a yellow background, in half-profile to the right. Painted in a gentle geometricizing generalisation, in places pastose, finished with palette knife.

9947.d: Tumepunasel taustal mehe nägu en face. Peas kergelt vasakule kaldu sonimüts. Kujutatu vasak silm sinakashalli ja parem silm punase täpina. Ekspressiivne ja geomeetriseeriv kujutamisviis, näo osad antud eri toonis värvilaikudena.
9947.de: A man's face en face against a dark red background. On his head a sonimüts [sonyi] cap tilted slightly to the left. The subject's left eye is bluish-grey and the right eye has a red dot. Expressive and geometricising manner of depiction, the parts of the face rendered as colour patches in different tones.

9948.d: Kollases, papaaha laadses mütsis prillidega mehe rindportree poolpöördes vasakule. Figuurist paremal ripub lambipirn, vasakul õla juures suunaga alla sõitev allveelaeva meenutav masin. Taust kollase ja pruuni värviga kaheks jaotunud. Maalitud skitseerivas laadis.
9948.de: Bust portrait of a man in a half-turn to the left, wearing a yellow, papakha-like hat and glasses. To the right of the figure a light bulb hangs, near the left shoulder a machine resembling a submarine descending downward. The background divided into two by yellow and brown colour. Painted in a sketchy style.

9949.d: Valgel taustal, markeeriva joonega maalitud mustades prillides mehe pea poolpöördes vasakule. Näo alaosa voolava värviga markeeritud. Visandlik maalilaad.
9949.de: On a white background, painted with a marking line, the head of a man in black glasses, in half-turn to the left. The lower part of the face marked with flowing paint. Sketch-like painting style.

9950.d: Värvilisel taustal abstraktne rindportree pöördes vasakule. Kujutatu näo eri osad antud suurte ekspressiivsete värvilaikudena. Laia sinise pintslitõmbega raamitud kollane nina. Punasega markeeritud pea- ja seljajoon.
9950.de: On a coloured background, an abstract bust portrait turned to the left. The different parts of the depicted person's face are given as large expressive patches of colour. A yellow nose framed by a broad blue brushstroke. Head and back line marked in red.

9956.d: Maalipinda katavad rohekas-pruunika fooniga, geomeetrilised, teineteise sisse koonduvad vormid. Kontrasti lisavad vormide heledalt antud osad. Teose keskel ümarjas, nägu meenutav kujutis, millel eristatavad silmad, roheline nina ja suu.
9956.de: The painted surface is covered with geometric, mutually converging forms on a greenish-brown background. Contrast is added by the lightly rendered parts of the forms. In the middle, a roundish, face-like image with distinguishable eyes, a green nose and mouth.

9963.d: Kollasel taustal värviline, abstraktne kujutis, milles tõuseb aktsendina esile laia pintsliga maalitud must struktuur.
9963.de: On a yellow background, a colourful, abstract image in which a black structure painted with a broad brush stands out as an accent.

9987.d: Toolil istuva sinises pluusis, miniseelikus ja kontsakingadega noore naise portree, käed põlvedel. Tugev vormiüldistus, taustaks rohekas sein ja punakas-violetne põrand.
9987.de: Portrait of a young woman sitting on a chair, in a blue blouse, a miniskirt and heeled shoes, hands on her knees. Strong formal generalisation, background a greenish wall and a reddish-violet floor.

9992.d: Rindportree naisest vasakus profiilis. Portreteeritul pruunid soengusse sätitud juuksed, seljas lilla kostüüm pruuni prossiga. Taustal tumesinised ja hallid värvipinnad.
9992.de: Half-length portrait of a woman in left profile. The sitter has brown hair arranged in a hairstyle, wearing a purple costume with a brown brooch. Background in dark blue and grey colour planes.

9994.d: Rindportree en face noorest naisest, kelle pilk on suunatud alla. Portreteeritul on õlgadeni pruunid juuksed, seljas tumepunane kampsun. Foonil tumedad pinnalaotused.
9994.de: Bust portrait en face of a young woman whose gaze is directed downward. The subject has brown hair to the shoulders, wearing a dark red sweater. Dark surfaces in the background.

9995.d: Punakates toonides orgaanilisteks värvipindadeks abstraheeritud inimfiguuriga kompositsioon. Keskmes kollase sõõri ääres põlvitav labidaga inimfiguur, taustal abstraktsed postjad vormid.
9995.de: A composition with a human figure abstracted into organic colour fields in reddish tones. In the centre, beside a yellow disc, a human figure kneeling with a spade, in the background abstract pillar-like forms.

10040.d: Kompositsioon rituaalsete esemetega, mis asetatud seisma tihedalt üksteise kõrvale.
10040.de: Composition with ritual objects placed standing closely next to one another.

10042.d: Tondoformaadis kunstniku pruunis pluusis portree kerge pöördega vasakule. Maalitud kuivalt, taust rohekas-kollakas.
10042.de: Tondo-format portrait of the artist in a brown blouse, with a slight turn to the left. Painted dry, background greenish-yellow.

10082.d: Tugevasti abstraheeritud prillidega mehe portree veerandpöördes vasakule. Mehel suus pastapliiatsiga joonistatud sigar, seljas V-kaelusega pluus, taust helehall.
10082.de: Strongly abstracted portrait of a man with glasses, in a quarter-turn to the left. The man has a cigar drawn with a ballpoint pen in his mouth, wearing a V-neck blouse, background light grey.

10093.d: Istuva naise portree veerandpöördes vasakule. Naisel tukk ja õlgadeni pruunid juuksed, huuled punased. Seljas tumesinine kostüüm, kaelas roheline sall ja sõrmes rohelise vääriskiviga sõrmus. Vasakus pildiservas peegel, mis peegeldab naise  juukseid ja diivani äärele toetuvat kätt.
10093.de: Portrait of a seated woman, three-quarter turned to the left. The woman has a fringe and shoulder-length brown hair, red lips. She wears a dark blue costume, a green scarf around her neck and a ring with a green gemstone on her finger. On the left edge of the picture a mirror, reflecting the woman's hair and the hand resting on the edge of the sofa.

10098.d: Pruunil, oranžikal ja sinakas-rohelisel taustal antud teravatipulised ekspressiivsed abstraktsed kujundid.
10098.de: Against a brown, orange, and bluish-green background, sharp-pointed expressive abstract forms are depicted.

10115.d: Turussteeni kujutav, visandlikult antud figuraalkompositsioon. Vasakul rohekate lillelettide kohal ümarad varjud, esiplaanil vasakul maas lillevaasides lilled, keskel ja paremal mitmeid figuurigruppe.
10115.de: A sketchily rendered figural composition depicting a market square. On the left, round shadows above greenish flower stalls, in the foreground on the left flowers in vases on the ground, in the middle and on the right several groups of figures.

10117.d: Pruunikasrohelisel taustal tumesinises ülikonnas meesterahva rindportree poolpöördes paremale.
10117.de: Bust portrait of a man in a dark blue suit against a brownish-green background, in half-turn to the right.

10122.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon punaste, siniste, mustade ja valgete pindadega.
10122.de: Abstract composition with red, blue, black and white surfaces.

10132.d: Reljeefne kompositsioon seitsmest naisest koos sirpide, reha ja heinahangiga. Taustal sinine taevas ja samblikku meenutav maastik.
10132.de: Relief composition of seven women with sickles, a rake and a hay fork. In the background a blue sky and a landscape resembling lichen.

10135.d: Otsevaates rindportree noorest naisest pruunide silmade ja õlgadeni juustega. Taust on beež.
10135.de: Frontal bust portrait of a young woman with brown eyes and hair reaching to the shoulders. The background is beige.

10143.d: Rindportree veerandpöördes paremale naisest, kes kannab sini-valge triibulist särki ja valget baretti. Taust tuhm roosa.
10143.de: Bust portrait in a quarter-turn to the right of a woman wearing a blue-and-white striped shirt and a white beret. Dull pink background.

10179.d: Lühikeste hallide juustega vanema naise rinnaportree otsevaates. Naisel seljas punase-kollasekirju pluus või kleit, millel vabalt langev valge jakk, peas punase-rohelisekirju väike müts. Näoosa tihedalt ihutoonides läbi maalitud, jakk modelleeritud pikkade roheliste pintslilöökidega, foon antud rohelistes ja kollakates toonides lühikeste pintslilöökidega.
10179.de: Frontal bust portrait of an older woman with short grey hair. The woman wears a red-and-yellow patterned blouse or dress, over which a loosely falling white jacket, and on her head a small red-and-green patterned cap. The facial area is densely painted through in skin tones, the jacket is modelled with long green brushstrokes, the background is rendered in green and yellowish tones with short brushstrokes.

10180.d: Valged, roosad ja lillad, pikliku kellukese kujulistest õitest koosnevad õiekobarad mitmes rohelises toonis antud lopsaka roheluse foonil.
10180.de: White, pink and purple clusters of flowers shaped like elongated bells, rendered in several shades of green against a background of lush greenery.

10184.d: Istuva hallipäise vanema daami kolmveerandfiguur poolpöörde vasakule, pilk vaatajal, käed süles. Naisel pidulik sallkraega tumesinine kleit seljas, pärlid kaelas. Taust figuuri ümber kollakas, kaugemalt kirsipunane. Rahutu ekspressiivne maalilaad.
10184.de: A three-quarter figure of a seated grey-haired elderly lady, turned half to the left, gaze on the viewer, hands in her lap. The woman wears a formal dark blue dress with a scarf collar, pearls around her neck. The background around the figure is yellowish, cherry-red further away. A restless, expressive painting style.

10185.d: Kaks pikakaelalist suurte silmaaukudega õnnistuseks tõstetud kätega valget olendit teineteise taga. Figuuride kaarjaid jooni kordavad tausta dekoratiivsed abstraktsed kujundid. Hallikad, beežid toonid.
10185.de: Two long-necked white beings with large eye sockets, hands raised in blessing, one behind the other. The curved lines of the figures are echoed by decorative abstract shapes in the background. Greyish, beige tones.

10188.d: Roheluse taustal põlvitav stiliseeritud figuur roosas kleidis, neljal käelabal valged linnud, lind õlal ja veidi kallutatud peas. Vormid siugjad, ümardatud.
10188.de: Against a green background a kneeling stylised figure in a pink dress, white birds on four hands, a bird on the shoulder and on the slightly tilted head. Forms sinuous, rounded.

10189.d: Spiraalist moodustuvas keras poolduva raku motiiv, mis kujutab ka kaht embuses figuuri. Kujund ümbritsetud värviliste kaleidoskoobi killukestega.
10189.de: The motif of a dividing cell forming a sphere of a spiral, which also depicts two figures in an embrace. The image is surrounded by coloured kaleidoscope fragments.

10190.d: Leentoolis istuva keskealise prillidega mehe figuur poolpöördes vasakule. Mehel ülepea kammitud juukse, pilk suunatud ette. Seljas tumesinine ülikond, valge särk, lips ees. Üks jalg üle teise, käed lebavad toolileenil.
10190.de: Figure of a middle-aged, bespectacled man sitting in an armchair, in a half-turn to the left. The man's hair is combed straight back, his gaze directed forward. Wearing a dark blue suit, a white shirt, a tie in front. One leg crossed over the other, hands resting on the armrests of the chair.

10205.d: Naise rinnapilt poolprofiilis vasakule.  Portreteeritul lühike tume soeng, seljas tumesinine pullover. Taust teostatud tumesinakates, rohekates ja hallikates toonides.
10205.de: Bust of a woman in half-profile facing left. The subject has short dark hair, wearing a dark blue pullover. The background is executed in dark bluish, greenish and greyish tones.

10214.d: Abstraktne kompositsioon- domineerivad värvid ooker, heleroosa, türkiissinine, pruun ja valge.
10214.de: Abstract composition - dominant colours ochre, light pink, turquoise blue, brown and white.

10231.d: Klaasesemetest komponeeritud natüürmort: vasakul klaasist puuviljavaas, milles sinised ja oranžid pallid, paremal kaks pokaali (ühes rohelised oksad). Sügavsinisel foonil ülal paremas nurgas kollase ja oranžiga maalitud kuu.
10231.de: A still life composed of glass objects: on the left a glass fruit vase containing blue and orange balls, on the right two goblets (in one, green branches). Against a deep blue background, in the upper right corner, a moon painted in yellow and orange.

10232.d: Värvilistest, omavahel põimunud ellipsitest kompositsioon tumedal foonil. Keskel väike helesinine ring.
10232.de: Composition of colored, interwoven ellipses on a dark background. A small light blue circle in the middle.

10238.d: Pintslit käes hoidva noore naiskunstniku autoportree ekspressiivses laadis. Kujutataval lühikesed pruunid juuksed, seljas kollakas pluus ja roheline seelik.
10238.de: Self-portrait of a young female artist holding a brush, in an expressive style. The subject has short brown hair, wears a yellowish blouse and a green skirt.

10239.d: Noore naiskunstniku autoportree en face koos Jumalaema ikooniga. Kunstnikul posipea, seljas punane pullover ja taustaks rohekas maaliline värvipind. Laias kuldses raamis Jumalaema ikoon kompositsiooni paremas osas.
10239.de: Young female artist's self-portrait en face together with an icon of the Mother of God. The artist has a headscarf, wears a red pullover, against a greenish painterly colour field. In a wide golden frame, the icon of the Mother of God in the right part of the composition.

10297.d: Maalipind jaotub horisontaalselt kaheks: domineeriv alumine pool koosneb punastest alpikannidest, mille keskel on sinine käsi ning ülemisel poolel on sinise tausta keskel üks punane alpikann.
10297.de: The painted surface is divided horizontally into two: the dominant lower half consists of red alpine gentians, with a blue hand at their centre, and the upper half has a single red alpine gentian at the centre of a blue background.

10298.d: Punastes toonides abstraktne kompositsioon siniste aktsentidega. Töö keskmes on vaataja poole pööratud käelaba, mille peal on kaks liblikat.
10298.de: An abstract composition in red tones with blue accents. At the centre of the work is a hand turned towards the viewer, on which are two butterflies.

10299.d: Värvikirev kompositsioon abstraktsete vormidega. Domineerivad ookerjad ja rohelised toonid - lilla ja sinine aktsent teose alumises paremas nurgas ja keskosas.
10299.de: Colourful composition with abstract forms. Ochre and green tones dominate - a purple and blue accent in the lower right corner and in the middle part of the work.

10300.d: Värvikirev kompositsioon abstraktsete vormidega kollakates-, sinakates, rohekates ja punakates toonides.

22101.d: Maali esiplaanil mäest alla sõitev suusataja - sinises pluusis pükstes ja mütsiga. Tema taga samuti alla laskuv pruunikates, punastes toonides suusataja. Esiplaanile maalitud nagu kahes suunas minev ristmik, vasakul küljel kuused, paremal pool kased lumiste okstega. Puude vahel suusatajad - kokku kaheksa.(eesti)
22101.de: In the foreground of the painting a skier descending a mountain - in a blue blouse, trousers and cap. Behind him another skier, also descending, in brownish, reddish tones. Painted in the foreground as if a crossroads leading in two directions, on the left side firs, on the right birches with snowy branches. Between the trees skiers - eight in all.

22105.dm: laius: 113.5 cm (koos raamiga); kõrgus: 80.6 cm (koos raamiga)
22105.d: Natüürmort õunte, pirnide, viinamarjade, veinipokaalide ja karahviniga laual. Maali keskne osa on ühtlaselt valgel pinnal- tasapinnal asetsevad puuviljad. Puuviljad on maalitud ruumiliselt, realistlikult. Õunad erinevate suuruste ja värvidega (6 tk), pirnid (7 tk) kõik sarnase kuju, suuruse ja värviga. Õunad, pirnid laua vasakul pool, paremal pool roosakas lillas toonides 2 ääreni veinipokaali ühel taldrikul, nende taga samades toonides veinikann, kannu kork eraldi laual. Viinamarja kobarad nagu ääristaksid ülalnimetatud esemeid. Taust kahes toonis ühtlaselt mururoheline, parem külg oranž.(eesti)
22105.de: Still life with apples, pears, grapes, wine goblets and a carafe on a table. The central part of the painting consists of fruit arranged on an evenly white surface-plane. The fruit is painted three-dimensionally, realistically. Apples of different sizes and colours (6 pcs), pears (7 pcs) all of similar shape, size and colour. Apples and pears on the left side of the table, on the right side, in pinkish-purple tones, 2 wine goblets filled to the brim on one plate, behind them a wine jug in the same tones, the jug's stopper separate on the table. Bunches of grapes seem to border the aforementioned objects. Background evenly grass-green in two tones, the right side orange.

22132.d: Kuldkollase taeva taustal järveäärne maastik, kus toimub rahvapidu. Maali esiplaanil vasakul pool (2/3 pildist) tantsivad ja seisavad inimesed. Pildi keskel istub seljaga vaataja poole pillimees(lõõts), paremal pool puu kõrval, luukere vikatiga. Paremal küljel näha puhkpillimängijad (4), kelle ees seisab kirikuõpetaja toetudes hauasambale, millele on kirjutatud - ORI. Hauale asetab naine kolme lapsega lilli. Maalitud naivistlikus laadis, väga värvikalt.(eesti). Asukoht objektil: keskel, maalitud kivi peale
22132.de: Against a golden-yellow sky, a lakeside landscape where a folk festival is taking place. In the foreground on the left side (2/3 of the picture) people are dancing and standing. In the middle of the picture, a musician (accordion) sits with his back to the viewer; on the right, next to a tree, a skeleton with a scythe. On the right side, wind instrument players (4) can be seen, in front of whom a pastor stands leaning on a gravestone inscribed - ORI. A woman with three children lays flowers on the grave. Painted in a naïve style, very colourfully. Location on object: in the centre, painted on a stone

22134.d: Figuraalkompositsioon : jõel suplevatest meestest ja neid trellitatud hoonest piiluvatest naistest. Maali esiplaanil paremal pool jõevee pind ja selles hullavad suplevad mehed. 32 erinevas asendis alasti meest on kujutatud vees ujumas, vett pritsimas, kaldal istumas, lamamas, maadlemas. Mehi on püütud kujutada üsna realistlikult, peamiselt roosakas-pruunides toonides. Välja on detailselt maalitud ka suguorganid. Maali vasakul pool all nurgas on kujutatud ülalt vaadates trellitatud akendega lahtise ülaosaga ruumi, kus 3 kübaras ja pikas kostüümis naist binoklitega ujuvaid mehi piiluvad. Müüri peal lebab 7 punast telliskivi kelluga.(eesti)
22134.de: Figural composition: of men bathing in a river and women peeking at them from a barred building. In the foreground on the right side, the surface of the river water in which the bathing men are frolicking. 32 naked men in various positions are depicted swimming in the water, splashing water, sitting on the shore, lying down, wrestling. The men have been depicted rather realistically, mainly in pinkish-brown tones. The genitals are also painted in detail. In the lower left corner of the painting, viewed from above, is depicted a room with barred windows and an open upper part, where 3 women in hats and long costumes are peeking at the swimming men with binoculars. On top of the wall lie 7 red bricks with a bell.(eesti)

22151.dm: laius: 49.8 cm (koos raamiga); kõrgus: 60.0 cm (koos raamiga)
22151.d: All paremast nurgast kasvab välja tume puude pöösate siluett. All vasakul küpskollane pind meenutab viljapõldu, silmapiiril taluhoone, metsatuka taga kirikutorn - nagu udus, helehall. Ülal paremas nurgas pilvede vahel kuu- öine maastik, tumedates toonides.(eesti)

22298.d: Esiplaanil veepind, parempoolses nurgas ranna ääres kõrged puud ja känd. Puude vahele on tušiga joonistatud jänes ja linnud. Keskel laudadest tehtud sillake. Tagaplaanil mets, puitehitised ja ümber piiratud aiaga maatükk. (eesti)

22300.d: Laukaline raba vasakul, kus ekskavaator kaevab kraavi. Esiplaanil kummardav mees mõõdupuuga ja temast paremal väljasirutatud käega ja mappi käeshoidev mees. Paremal künnab traktor põldu. Tagaplaanil kaks hoonet, kuusk ja madal mets. (eesti)
22300.de: A hummocky bog on the left, where an excavator is digging a ditch. In the foreground a man bending over with a measuring stick, and to his right a man with an outstretched arm holding a folder. On the right a tractor ploughs a field. In the background two buildings, a spruce and low forest.

22442.d: Talutuba kujutav dekoratsioon: palkseinad, 2 ust, ahi paremal. Keskel pilak valgustandva peeruga, vokk.(eesti)
22442.de: Decoration depicting a farmhouse room: log walls, 2 doors, a stove on the right. In the middle a stand with a burning splinter for light, a spinning wheel.

22443.d: Päikesepaisteline metsalagendik suure kiviga keskel. Selle kõrval kuusk ja kased mõlemal pool. Ülal raamib ümarkaarselt kulgev must foon kujundust.(eesti)
22443.de: A sunlit forest clearing with a large stone in the middle. Beside it a spruce and birches on both sides. Above, a black background curving in an arch frames the composition.

22475.d: Kalapaatide sild Pärnu jõel Loosi all. Pika silla ääres mootorpurjekad allalastud purjedega ja väiksemad mootorpaadid. Esiplaanil vees peegelduvad purjekate mastid. Tumeda viiruna paistab  üle laia jõepinna Ülejõe kallas puudega. (eesti)
22475.de: Bridge for fishing boats on the Pärnu River below Loosi. Along the long bridge motor sailboats with lowered sails and smaller motorboats. In the foreground the masts of the sailboats reflected in the water. Across the wide river surface, the Ülejõe bank with trees appears as a dark streak.

22476.d: Eest tahapoole künkale tõusev tee, mis viib taluhooneteni. Teed piirab kahelt poolt postidega latt-tara, mis kohati katkenud. Korstnaga elamu, hoonete kõrval heinakuhi ja majade juures kõrged kased. Paremal üksikud puud. (eesti)
22476.de: A road rising from the front backwards onto a hillock, leading to the farm buildings. The road is bordered on both sides by a picket fence with posts, broken in places. A dwelling with a chimney, a haystack beside the buildings, and tall birches near the houses. Individual trees on the right.

22477.d: Eest tahapoole kulgev lai tee kiviaedade vahel. Esiplaanil teel veelombid. Mõlemal pool tee kõrval püramiidkadakad, vasakul aia taga kollakas väli. (eesti)
22477.de: A wide road running from the front backwards between stone fences. In the foreground, puddles on the road. On both sides of the road, pyramidal junipers, on the left behind the fence a yellowish field.

22480.d: Palkseinte, laudpõranda ja taladega laega ruum. Vasakul ukse kõrval ripuvad tööriistad ja riided, tagaseinas suur reheahi. Ahjust paremal pliit, mille ääres toimetab kollakas pluusis naine. Pliidil suur sangaga pada, pliidisuu ees väike pink. Tagaseina ääres pingil veeämber.(eesti)
22480.de: A room with log walls, a plank floor and a ceiling with beams. On the left, next to the door, hang tools and clothes, in the back wall a large threshing-barn oven. To the right of the oven a stove, at which a woman in a yellowish blouse is busy. On the stove a large pot with a handle, in front of the stove opening a small bench. By the back wall, on a bench, a water bucket.

22481.d: Palkseinte ja laudpõrandaga ruum. Vasak sein pikuti laudadest. Seinal maalitud numbrilaua ja rippuvate pommidega kell. Tagaseinas suur ahi ahjukapiga, kus küünlajalg. Ahju ääres puuvoodi, millel rohekas vaip. Vaiba alt paistab valge palakas ja väike padi. Voodi ees järi. Paremal ukse küljes ripub kuub.(eesti)
22481.de: A room with log walls and a plank floor. The left wall is lined with horizontal planks. On the wall a painted clock with a numbered dial and hanging weights. In the rear wall a large stove with a stove cupboard, on which a candlestick. Beside the stove a wooden bed with a greenish blanket. Under the blanket a white cloth and a small pillow show. A stool in front of the bed. On the right a coat hangs on the door.
